policy.zh: 简介仅写核心玩法，类型由游戏索引分类展示。具体游戏ID对应独立资料；详细介绍使用游戏官网、作者页、游戏百科或官方项目文档。论文仅用于研究出处，不作为游戏详情外链。
policy.en: Gameplay copy is curated for exact game IDs. Readable details use game sites, author pages, encyclopedias or official project docs; papers remain research provenance.

entries.zh: 每次移动会让所有数字方块沿同一方向滑动，相同数值碰撞后合并；玩家需要为后续合并保留空间。
entries.en: Each move shifts all tiles in one direction and merges equal values; preserving free space enables larger combinations.

entries.zh: 玩家扮演辩护律师成步堂龙一，调查案件、收集证据，并在庭审中追问证人、找出证词矛盾，逐步还原案件真相。
entries.en: As defense attorney Phoenix Wright, investigate cases, gather evidence and challenge contradictory testimony to uncover the truth.

entries.zh: 在三色浆果间选择种植方案，各颜色占比会影响生长率，需要协调产量与偏好。
entries.en: A harvesting game about planting three berry colors whose population shares affect regrowth.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起偏好不一致的协调；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered coordination with conflicting preferences in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起偏好不一致的协调；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered coordination with conflicting preferences in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 搬运反应物维持三条产食代谢循环，用循环副产物再生能源。
entries.en: A chemistry environment: transport reactants to sustain three food-producing cycles and recycle energy.

entries.zh: 搬运反应物维持三条产食代谢循环，用循环副产物再生能源，同时处理具有独立收益的干扰分子。
entries.en: A chemistry environment: transport reactants to sustain three food-producing cycles and recycle energy, with additional rewarding distractor molecules.

entries.zh: 搬运反应物维持两条产食代谢循环，用循环副产物再生能源。
entries.en: A chemistry environment: transport reactants to sustain two food-producing cycles and recycle energy.

entries.zh: 搬运反应物维持两条产食代谢循环，用循环副产物再生能源，同时处理具有独立收益的干扰分子。
entries.en: A chemistry environment: transport reactants to sustain two food-producing cycles and recycle energy, with additional rewarding distractor molecules.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起鹰鸽对抗；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered hawk–dove choices in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起鹰鸽对抗；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered hawk–dove choices in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 采苹果获得收益，但河道污染会阻止果实再生，需要分工清污与采收。
entries.en: A harvesting game where river pollution suppresses apple regrowth, requiring a balance between cleaning and collecting.

entries.zh: 在非对称双房间中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in asymmetric rooms: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 在环形通道中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in a circuit layout: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 在狭窄厨房中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in a cramped kitchen: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 在可互相穿行的拥挤厨房中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in a crowded passable kitchen: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 在八字通道中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in a figure-eight layout: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 在强制分工的双房间中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in separate rooms requiring handoffs: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 在环状通道中分工收集番茄、煮汤、装碗和交付，所有玩家共享订单收益。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game in a ring layout: gather tomatoes, cook soup, bowl it and deliver for shared rewards.

entries.zh: 占守自然围合的果区，在抵御外来者的同时避免过度采收。
entries.en: A harvesting game about defending enclosed orchards while avoiding overharvesting.

entries.zh: 苹果再生依赖周围未采果实，需要在即时采收与保留再生能力之间取舍。
entries.en: A shared orchard game where apple regrowth depends on nearby fruit, creating a harvest-versus-sustainability tradeoff.

entries.zh: 伙伴共同守住两个入口，协调采收以维持共享果区的再生。
entries.en: A partnership harvesting game about defending two entrances and maintaining shared orchard regrowth.

entries.zh: 铁矿可独立开采，金矿需要恰好两人在短时间内配合开采。
entries.en: A mining game with solo iron extraction and gold requiring exactly two coordinated miners.

entries.zh: 不同蘑菇的食用会影响自己和他人的收益，密集生长还要求绕开或清除不利蘑菇。
entries.en: A dense mushroom-foraging game where consumption affects personal and other players’ rewards.

entries.zh: 采集苹果与香蕉，围绕个人偏好交易或消费；穿越同心水道还会消耗体力。
entries.en: A fruit-trading game with personal preferences, harvesting and consumption, plus stamina costs for crossing concentric rivers.

entries.zh: 收集代币后可直接消费，或加工成更高阶代币赠给其他玩家。
entries.en: A resource game about consuming tokens or refining them into higher-tier gifts for others.

entries.zh: 喷涂地面、射击对手并争夺敌旗，站在不同颜色地面上会改变生命上限。
entries.en: A team paintball capture-the-flag game where painted ground affects health during movement and firefights.

entries.zh: 喷涂并控制地图中央区域，同时利用地面颜色获得战斗优势。
entries.en: A team paintball game about coloring and controlling the central hill.

entries.zh: 猎物在有死胡同的迷宫采食苹果，捕食者利用狭窄通道围捕。
entries.en: A predator-prey game with apple foraging in a maze of dangerous dead-end corridors.

entries.zh: 猎物采集苹果与橡果，可结群防御或将橡果带回草丛进食。
entries.en: An open-field predator-prey game with group defense and transporting acorns to safer grass.

entries.zh: 猎物选择苹果或橡果采集路线，并利用附近高草区域躲避捕食者。
entries.en: An orchard predator-prey game with alternative apple and acorn routes near safe grass.

entries.zh: 猎物采集橡果，利用分散草丛延缓追捕，但没有完全安全的庇护区。
entries.en: A forest predator-prey game with acorn foraging and scattered grass that obstructs pursuit without offering full safety.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起合作或背叛；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered cooperation or defection in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起合作或背叛；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered cooperation or defection in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起三种等价协调选择；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered three equally rewarded coordination choices in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起三种等价协调选择；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered three equally rewarded coordination choices in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起三种回报不同的协调选择；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered three coordination choices with differing rewards in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起三种回报不同的协调选择；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered three coordination choices with differing rewards in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起石头剪刀布循环克制；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered cyclic rock–paper–scissors payoffs in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起石头剪刀布循环克制；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered cyclic rock–paper–scissors payoffs in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起猎鹿或猎兔的风险协调；此版本采用多人场地。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered risky stag-versus-hare coordination in a multiplayer arena.

entries.zh: 移动收集资源，再通过交互光束发起猎鹿或猎兔的风险协调；此版本采用双人重复互动。
entries.en: Collect resources and initiate beam-triggered risky stag-versus-hare coordination in repeated two-player interactions.

entries.zh: 从外围进入资源墙迷宫，为墙面上色并守住已占区域以持续获取收益。
entries.en: A territory game about moving inward through a resource-wall maze, painting walls and holding claims.

entries.zh: 起始房间形成自然边界，可守住资源墙，也可破墙入侵而永久损失被毁资源。
entries.en: A territorial game with starting rooms, claimable walls and destructive invasion across natural boundaries.

entries.zh: 选择收益共享组，再由互补工种采集和制作资源。
entries.en: Choose a reward-sharing group, then gather and craft with complementary roles.

entries.zh: 玩家采集资源、发展城镇并跨越时代，生产和指挥军队，通过经济与军事扩张击败对手。
entries.en: A historical real-time strategy game about resource gathering, town development, age advancement and commanding armies.

entries.zh: 玩家调配村民采集四类资源，建造城镇和军队、研究升级，并通过侦察与兵种配合争夺地图。
entries.en: A medieval real-time strategy game combining four-resource economies, settlement building, upgrades, scouting and army composition.

entries.zh: 13×7 网格双人回合制对抗；摧毁基地或外交终局
entries.en: Turn-based 13×7 duel with base destruction or diplomatic endings

entries.zh: 通过私聊、公开陈述和投票存活并赢得终局
entries.en: Survive through private discussion, public pitches and votes, then win the final jury

entries.zh: 推进具有前置依赖的主线，并探索、合成和完成支线。
entries.en: Advance prerequisite-linked main quests, explore, craft and complete side quests.

entries.zh: 玩家使用药水改变石头的属性，观察结果，并利用推断出的规则选择后续操作。
entries.en: An environment with hidden transformation rules. Use potions to alter stones, observe the results and apply the inferred rules to later decisions.

entries.zh: 同步采矿、限时交接、共同建造与战斗
entries.en: Synchronised mining, timed handovers, cooperative construction and combat

entries.zh: 玩家通过导航、取放、清洁、加热和冷却操作，使物体到达指令要求的位置或状态。
entries.en: Household interaction tasks combining navigation, placement, cleaning, heating and cooling to reach specified object states.

entries.zh: 一款双人封路棋。玩家先像国际象棋皇后般移动一个亚马逊，再射箭封住一格，争取让对手无合法行动。
entries.en: A two-player blocking game: move an Amazon queen-wise, then shoot an arrow to block a square and immobilize the opponent.

entries.zh: 船员完成任务并寻找伪装者，伪装者则通过破坏和伪装干扰团队，会议讨论与投票决定嫌疑人。
entries.en: Crewmates complete tasks and identify impostors, while impostors sabotage and deceive; meetings use discussion and voting.

entries.zh: 玩家选择弹射角度和力度，利用鸟类特性破坏建筑并消灭其中的猪；Science Birds 为研究用实现。
entries.en: A physics slingshot puzzle about toppling structures and eliminating pigs; Science Birds is a research implementation.

entries.zh: 一款 4×3 迷你将棋。双方移动狮、象、长颈鹿与小鸡，吃子后可重新打入棋盘，争取吃掉对方狮子或达成入阵条件。
entries.en: A 4×3 shogi variant with animal pieces, captures and drops, won by capturing the opposing lion or a qualifying try.

entries.zh: 控制角色跑跳、收集金币并避开敌人；寻找强化道具，跳上更高平台或穿过原本受阻的通路。
entries.en: Run, jump, collect coins and avoid enemies; find power-ups that unlock higher jumps and blocked passages.

entries.zh: 玩家利用角色技能、枪械和小队配合，在收缩区域中搜集装备、转移并击败对手。
entries.en: A hero-based battle-royale shooter combining weapons, character abilities, squad coordination, looting and movement through a shrinking arena.

entries.zh: 每队4条鱼的对战中选择攻击/技能；第二阶段另有隐藏身份猜测
entries.en: Choose attacks/skills in four-fish teams; stage two also includes hidden-identity guesses

entries.zh: 玩家携带装备进入战区搜集战利品，与敌人交战并到达撤离点；成功撤离才能保留带出的物资。
entries.en: A tactical extraction shooter about entering raids, gathering loot, managing equipment and reaching extraction to retain supplies.

entries.zh: 各队让全部成员穿过路口先到达对侧目标。
entries.en: Get all teammates across the junction to opposite targets before the other team.

entries.zh: 玩家扮演艾吉奥探索君士坦丁堡，以攀爬、潜行与战斗追查钥匙，并进入阿泰尔相关记忆。
entries.en: A historical action adventure following Ezio through Constantinople, combining climbing, stealth, combat and the search for memory-bearing keys.

entries.zh: 通过倾斜迷宫让小球沿通道滚动，控制惯性并到达出口。
entries.en: Tilt a maze to roll a ball through corridors toward the exit.

entries.zh: Atari 2600 主机游戏的模拟环境，包含射击、平台、竞速、运动和棋类作品，各游戏保留各自目标与计分规则。
entries.en: Emulated Atari 2600 games spanning shooters, platformers, racing, sports and board games, each retaining its own objectives and scoring.

entries.zh: 横向移动飞船击落来袭飞碟，保护画面两侧的建筑免遭轰炸。
entries.en: Move a ship sideways, shoot saucers and defend two buildings from bombs.

entries.zh: 在飞船迷宫中清除异形卵、躲避异形，利用喷火器和临时强化争取生存。
entries.en: Clear eggs from a spaceship maze, evade aliens and use a flamethrower and temporary power-ups.

entries.zh: 沿网格路径移动并完成区域描边，同时避开追逐的敌人。
entries.en: Traverse grid paths and enclose areas while avoiding pursuing enemies.

entries.zh: 横向操纵战车，击落母舰释放的无人机并躲避其射击。
entries.en: Move a vehicle sideways, destroy deployed drones and dodge their fire.

entries.zh: 在横向流动的物品间移动，收集奖励物并避开会损失生命的竖琴。
entries.en: Collect moving reward items while avoiding harmful lyres.

entries.zh: 在太空中转向和推进，射碎小行星并避开飞碟和碰撞。
entries.en: Rotate and thrust through space, fragment asteroids and avoid saucers and collisions.

entries.zh: 操作三座防御炮台击落来袭敌机，阻止水下城市设施被摧毁。
entries.en: Use three defense posts to shoot attackers before they destroy the underwater city's installations.

entries.zh: 驾驶逃跑汽车穿越城市迷宫抢银行，管理燃料并利用炸药摆脱警车。
entries.en: Rob banks through maze-like streets, managing fuel and using dynamite to evade police cars.

entries.zh: 用摇杆选择数值答案，完成屏幕给出的基础算术题。
entries.en: Select numeric answers with the joystick to solve arithmetic problems.

entries.zh: 以第一人称驾驶坦克，利用雷达寻找敌方载具并射击。
entries.en: Drive a first-person tank, locate vehicles with radar and destroy them.

entries.zh: 在固定轨道间横向切换，射击迎面敌舰并躲避攻击与太空残骸。
entries.en: Switch sideways between lanes, shoot enemy ships and dodge attacks and debris.

entries.zh: 穿越带致命墙壁的机器人迷宫，射击敌人并寻找安全出口。
entries.en: Navigate robot-filled mazes, shooting enemies while avoiding lethal walls.

entries.zh: 控制保龄球投球，在十局中尽量击倒更多球瓶并取得全中或补中。
entries.en: Bowl across ten frames, aiming for strikes, spares and a high pin count.

entries.zh: 在拳台中移动与出拳，命中对手得分并争取击倒。
entries.en: Move and punch in a boxing ring to score hits and knock out the opponent.

entries.zh: 左右移动挡板反弹小球，击碎顶部砖墙并避免球从底部落出。
entries.en: Move a paddle to rebound a ball, break the brick wall and avoid losing the ball below.

entries.zh: 移动枪口射击横向目标，节省有限弹药并阻止小鸡偷走子弹。
entries.en: Shoot moving targets while conserving ammunition and stopping bullet-stealing chickens.

entries.zh: 操控底部角色射击蜈蚣、蜘蛛和跳蚤，躲避接近的敌人。
entries.en: Shoot centipedes, spiders and fleas while evading approaching enemies.

entries.zh: 驾驶直升机击落敌机，保护地面卡车车队并借助小地图掌握威胁。
entries.en: Pilot a helicopter, shoot enemy aircraft and protect truck convoys using the minimap.

entries.zh: 交替控制攀爬动作登上大楼，躲开关闭的窗户和坠物，抵达顶部直升机。
entries.en: Climb buildings, avoid closing windows and falling objects, and reach the rooftop helicopter.

entries.zh: 左右移动并射击成波恶魔，躲避反击以保住剩余生命。
entries.en: Shoot waves of demons while dodging attacks and preserving lives.

entries.zh: 进行二对二篮球对抗，选择战术后跑位、传球和投篮争取得分。
entries.en: Play two-on-two basketball, selecting plays and executing movement, passes and shots.

entries.zh: 扮演特工乘电梯和楼梯下楼，取得红门房间的文件并与敌方特工交战后逃离。
entries.en: Use elevators and stairs to retrieve documents, fight agents and escape at ground level.

entries.zh: 在昼夜变化的赛道上驾驶赛车，每天超越规定数量的车辆才能继续。
entries.en: Race through changing days and nights, overtaking the required number of cars to continue.

entries.zh: 控制钓线争抢鱼群，设法比对手钓到更多鱼。
entries.en: Control a fishing line and catch more fish than the opponent.

entries.zh: 引导小鸡穿越多条繁忙车道，躲开车辆并抵达马路对面。
entries.en: Guide a chicken across busy traffic lanes without being hit.

entries.zh: 在浮冰之间跳跃并改变冰块颜色，逐块建造冰屋，躲避北极环境中的危险。
entries.en: Hop across ice floes to change their colors and build an igloo while avoiding hazards.

entries.zh: 控制持铲农夫堵住地洞，阻止地鼠偷走三根胡萝卜。
entries.en: Use a shovel to block tunnels and stop a gopher stealing three carrots.

entries.zh: 驾驶受重力影响的飞船进入各星球，控制推力并攻击地面目标。
entries.en: Control a gravity-affected spacecraft, enter planets and attack ground targets.

entries.zh: 利用旋翼背包、炸药和激光深入矿井，在能量耗尽前救出受困矿工。
entries.en: Use a propeller pack, dynamite and lasers to rescue miners before energy runs out.

entries.zh: 调整大炮发射参数，把人体炮弹准确射入水塔目标。
entries.en: Adjust cannon launch parameters to land a human projectile inside a water tower.

entries.zh: 操控冰球队员传球和射门，在限定比赛时间内争取更多进球。
entries.en: Pass and shoot the puck to outscore the opponent in a timed hockey match.

entries.zh: 控制可跳跃和潜水的特种载具，发射炸弹与斜向射击以完成各阶段任务。
entries.en: Pilot a jumping and diving craft, using bombs and angled shots to complete missions.

entries.zh: 引导乐队成员穿过后台人群和障碍，在限时内到达逃生车辆并保护演出收入。
entries.en: Guide band members through crowds and backstage obstacles to the escape vehicle while protecting concert cash.

entries.zh: 控制袋鼠妈妈爬梯、拾取水果并拳击猴子，设法救出幼崽。
entries.en: Climb ladders, collect fruit and punch monkeys as a mother kangaroo rescuing her baby.

entries.zh: 接住并放下彩色方块，排出三个或更多同色块的连线。
entries.en: Catch and place colored tiles to form lines of three or more matching tiles.

entries.zh: 在多个动作场景中寻找会变动位置的黑色城堡，救出公主并击败野兽。
entries.en: Navigate action stages, locate the shifting Black Fortress, rescue the princess and defeat the Beast.

entries.zh: 在寺庙各层近身格斗，击退敌人并向上推进以救出公主。
entries.en: Fight through temple floors, defeat enemies and rescue the princess.

entries.zh: 在多房间遗迹中跳跃和攀爬，收集钥匙与宝物，避开机关和致命生物。
entries.en: Jump and climb through linked chambers, collecting keys and treasure while avoiding traps and creatures.

entries.zh: 在迷宫中吃掉所有豆子，同时躲避幽灵并利用能量豆反击。
entries.en: Clear pellets from a maze, evade ghosts and use power pellets to turn the chase around.

entries.zh: 在海底守护宝藏，抵御鲨鱼与章鱼，同时留意并补充氧气。
entries.en: Defend underwater treasure from a shark and octopus while managing oxygen.

entries.zh: 轮流落子夹住并翻转对方棋子，争取在终局拥有更多己方棋子。
entries.en: Place discs to bracket and flip opposing discs, seeking the largest final count.

entries.zh: 击落成波鸟形敌机并躲避炸弹，最后突破防御攻击外星驾驶员。
entries.en: Shoot waves of bird-like enemies, dodge bombs and reach the alien pilot.

entries.zh: 在限时丛林冒险中奔跑、跳跃和摆荡，绕过陷阱并收集宝物。
entries.en: Run, jump and swing through a jungle, avoiding traps and collecting treasure before time expires.

entries.zh: 上下移动球拍反弹小球，阻止对手得分并把球打入对方底线。
entries.en: Move a paddle vertically to return the ball and send it past the opponent.

entries.zh: 控制上下移动的母猪射箭，击破狼的气球并躲开投石，保护幼崽。
entries.en: Move vertically and shoot wolves' balloons while dodging stones and protecting piglets.

entries.zh: 驾车和步行调查城市，收集证据与赃物，在时限内完成案件。
entries.en: Investigate city streets, collect evidence and stolen goods, and solve cases before deadlines.

entries.zh: 在金字塔方块间跳跃，把所有方块变成目标颜色并避开敌人。
entries.en: Hop across a pyramid to change every cube to the target color while avoiding enemies.

entries.zh: 驾驶战机沿河飞行，射击敌舰与设施，避开河岸并及时经过油库补充燃料。
entries.en: Fly along a river, shoot targets, avoid banks and replenish fuel at depots.

entries.zh: 控制走鹃奔跑和跳跃，收集路上种子，躲开郊狼、车辆与沙漠机关。
entries.en: Run and jump as Road Runner, collecting seeds while evading the coyote, traffic and traps.

entries.zh: 驾驶坦克射击敌方中队，规避火箭并在仪表与画面受损时继续作战。
entries.en: Command tanks against enemy squadrons, dodging rockets and coping with damaged sensors.

entries.zh: 驾驶潜艇射击鲨鱼和敌潜艇、接回潜水员，并定期上浮补充氧气。
entries.en: Pilot a submarine, shoot enemies, rescue divers and surface to replenish oxygen.

entries.zh: 控制滑雪者穿过旗门，避开树木并用尽可能少的时间完成赛道。
entries.en: Steer a skier through gates, avoid trees and minimize course time.

entries.zh: 驾驶飞船在不同星区间跃迁，保卫联邦星球、摧毁敌军并补充燃料。
entries.en: Warp between sectors, defend Federation planets, destroy enemy forces and refuel.

entries.zh: 横向移动激光炮台，消灭不断下降的外星方阵，并躲避敌方射击。
entries.en: Move a laser cannon sideways, shoot descending alien formations and dodge return fire.

entries.zh: 射击来袭飞碟与外星生物，避开炸弹以阻止入侵。
entries.en: Shoot incoming saucers and creatures while avoiding bombs.

entries.zh: 控制不断延伸的移动轨迹，设法围住对手，同时避免撞到边界或已有轨迹。
entries.en: Extend a moving trail to trap the opponent without colliding with boundaries or existing trails.

entries.zh: 操控球员移动、接球和击球，按网球局分规则争取赢得比赛。
entries.en: Move, return shots and place the ball to win games under tennis scoring rules.

entries.zh: 驾驶飞机击落四周敌机，随着关卡推进迎战不同时代的飞行器。
entries.en: Pilot an aircraft against surrounding enemies from progressively later technological eras.

entries.zh: 在陵墓迷宫中寻找宝物，射击守卫并避开危险通道。
entries.en: Search tomb mazes for treasure while shooting guardians and avoiding hazards.

entries.zh: 驾驶越野车沿道路收集旗标和奖励，并通过跳跃消灭或避开车辆。
entries.en: Drive and jump along roads, collecting flags and prizes while handling opposing vehicles.

entries.zh: 进入地牢各房间射击怪物并取得宝藏，避免被围困。
entries.en: Enter dungeon chambers, shoot monsters and recover treasure.

entries.zh: 操作弹球台让球尽量保持运动，利用反弹命中目标累积分数。
entries.en: Keep a pinball in play, rebounding it into targets to accumulate points.

entries.zh: 在迷宫中利用激光与雷达搜寻敌人，击败怪物和巫师。
entries.en: Use a laser and radar to hunt monsters and the Wizard through a maze.

entries.zh: 破坏敌人的护盾，为强力炮击打通路径并摧毁 Qotile。
entries.en: Breach a shield to open a firing path and destroy the Qotile with the Zorlon Cannon.

entries.zh: 操纵斜视角战机穿过敌方防线，射击设施与敌机并避开障碍。
entries.en: Pilot an isometric fighter through defenses, shooting targets and avoiding obstacles.

entries.zh: 玩家复制到邻格或跳到两格外，落点附近的敌子会转为己方颜色，终局比较棋子数。
entries.en: A board-control game about cloning or jumping pieces, converting adjacent opponents and maximizing the final count.

entries.zh: 玩家提队、投票并执行任务，善方争取任务成功，同时防止梅林在终局被刺杀。
entries.en: A social deduction game of team proposals, voting and quests. Good must complete quests while keeping Merlin safe from assassination.

entries.zh: 玩家推动物体和文字，重组“主体—关系—属性”规则，改变碰撞关系或获胜条件以解开关卡。
entries.en: A grid-based research adaptation of Baba Is You. Push objects and words to rewrite rules governing properties, movement and victory.

entries.zh: 玩家既要移动角色，也能重组场景中的规则语句，改变物体属性与获胜条件。
entries.en: Move both characters and word blocks, rearranging rule sentences to change object properties and win conditions.

entries.zh: 角色按指令寻找物体、拾取钥匙、开门或摆放物体，部分关卡要求依次执行多个子目标。
entries.en: Instruction-following grid tasks involving object search, pickup, doors and placement, sometimes composed into multi-step goals.

entries.zh: 一款双人掷骰竞走棋。玩家依骰点移动棋子、阻挡和击回对方单子，率先把所有己方棋子移出棋盘。
entries.en: A two-player dice race involving movement, blocking and hitting lone checkers before bearing off all pieces.

entries.zh: 通过文字指令探索场景、寻找卷轴并学习法术，利用咒语之间的相互作用和物品谜题推进冒险。
entries.en: Explore through text commands, discover scrolls and learn spells, combining magical effects and objects to solve puzzles.

entries.zh: 玩家为冷僻问题编写可信解释，再从真伪混杂的选项中投票找出正确答案。
entries.en: A party game about inventing plausible answers and identifying the real one among submitted bluffs.

entries.zh: 双方都希望选择相同行动，但各自更偏爱不同的协调结果。
entries.en: A coordination game in which both players prefer matching actions but favor different coordinated outcomes.

entries.zh: 玩家轮流攻击坐标，根据命中与落空反馈寻找并击沉对手舰船。
entries.en: Attack coordinates in turn and use hit-or-miss feedback to locate and sink the opponent’s ships.

entries.zh: 玩家经营金属与能源经济、建造生产和防御设施，实时调动陆海空军作战。
entries.en: A large-scale real-time strategy game with metal and energy economies, production, defenses and land, sea and air armies.

entries.zh: 玩家使用棍术、法术和变身迎战妖怪与首领，探索场景并发展战斗技能。
entries.en: An action RPG inspired by Chinese mythology, featuring staff combat, spells, transformations, exploration and boss encounters.

entries.zh: 玩家在要牌与停牌之间选择，争取接近 21 点并避免超点。
entries.en: A card game against a dealer. Decide whether to hit or stand, aiming to approach 21 without exceeding it.

entries.zh: 玩家选择具有不同技能的角色，配合战斗并争夺据点或收集目标资源。
entries.en: A team brawler focused on melee combat, distinct character abilities, point control and objective-resource collection.

entries.zh: 两位玩家选择兼容动作序列，获得 S 或更高的 G 终局奖励。
entries.en: Two players choose compatible sequences for terminal reward S or the higher G.

entries.zh: 在俯视角场景探索和放置炸弹，击败怪物取得物品与能力，并用新能力打开后续区域。
entries.en: Explore top-down areas, defeat monsters with bombs and use acquired abilities to open later routes.

entries.zh: 把握弹跳时机，让不断前进的小方块越过尖刺和平台间隙。
entries.en: Time jumps to guide an advancing cube over spikes and gaps.

entries.zh: 浏览器实现。左右移动挡板反弹小球，击碎顶部砖墙并避免球从底部落出。
entries.en: A browser implementation. An Atari 2600 game: Move a paddle to rebound a ball, break the brick wall and avoid losing the ball below.

entries.zh: 双方先通过叫牌确定定约，再根据花色、将牌和牌张分布协同争取足够墩数。
entries.en: A four-player partnership trick-taking game combining an auction, contracts, trumps and coordinated card play.

entries.zh: 穿过 N×N 网格抵达稀疏奖励终点。
entries.en: Traverse an N×N grid to the sparse-reward goal.

entries.zh: 选择突击、支援、医疗或狙击干员，协调技能、共享敌情并互相支援，在合作任务或队伍对抗中完成作战目标。
entries.en: Choose Assault, Support, Medic or Marksman operators, coordinate abilities and share enemy information to complete cooperative or competitive objectives.

entries.zh: 玩家交换相邻糖果，组成同色连线、触发消除与连锁，并在关卡限制内完成目标。
entries.en: Swap neighboring candies to form matching lines, trigger cascades and satisfy level objectives within their limits.

entries.zh: 控制 Callisto 跳跃和使用喷气背包穿越太空关卡，避开障碍并抵达出口。
entries.en: Guide Callisto through space stages using jumps and a jetpack, avoiding obstacles to reach the exit.

entries.zh: 多数玩家知道秘密词，通过一词线索交流；变色龙不知道该词，需要伪装并尝试猜出答案。
entries.en: A social deduction game using one-word clues; the uninformed Chameleon must blend in and infer the secret word.

entries.zh: 双方利用六类棋子的不同走法展开攻防，以将死对方国王为目标，也可能形成和棋。
entries.en: A turn-based board game with six piece types and distinct moves. Players seek checkmate while protecting their king.

entries.zh: 玩家控制恐龙跳过仙人掌、躲避飞鸟，在速度逐渐增加的情况下尽量延长奔跑距离。
entries.en: An endless runner: jump over cacti and dodge birds as the dinosaur's forward speed increases.

entries.zh: 玩家规划道路与区域、建设公共服务，并平衡交通、预算和城市居民的需求。
entries.en: A city-building simulation. Plan roads and districts, provide public services and balance traffic, budgets and residents’ needs.

entries.zh: 玩家从早期聚落开始建城、研究科技和探索地图，通过经济、外交与战争发展文明。
entries.en: A turn-based civilization strategy game about founding cities, research, exploration, diplomacy and warfare.

entries.zh: 玩家经营城市、研究科技和政策，开展外交并指挥军队争取不同胜利条件。
entries.en: A hex-map turn-based strategy game combining cities, research, social policies, diplomacy and armies across multiple victory paths.

entries.zh: 玩家布局城市区域、发展科技与文化，并围绕地形、外交和军事力量选择胜利路线。
entries.en: A turn-based civilization game emphasizing city-district placement, science, culture, terrain, diplomacy and warfare.

entries.zh: 描述者避免目标词及禁词，帮助猜词者识别目标。
entries.en: A describer avoids the target and forbidden words while helping a guesser identify the concept.

entries.zh: 线索提供者用一个词关联多个目标词，队友据此猜测，同时避开对方词语和危险选项。
entries.en: Give a one-word clue linking target words, then have teammates guess while avoiding opposing and dangerous words.

entries.zh: 玩家跳过地形和敌人，抵达关卡末端的金币。
entries.en: The original CoinRun is a procedural platformer about crossing terrain and enemies to reach a final coin.

entries.zh: 两个代理通过图上移动共同捕捉对手。
entries.en: Two agents coordinate graph movements to capture an adversary.

entries.zh: 协作启动分布在不同房间的两个发电机，打开出口并避开追捕者。
entries.en: Activate two generators in different rooms, unlock the exit and evade the pursuer.

entries.zh: 在多个战场分配固定兵力，以赢得更多战场。
entries.en: Allocate a fixed troop budget across battlefields to win more battlefields.

entries.zh: 通过文字命令探索地下洞穴，检查与使用物品、破解环境谜题，并搜集散落的宝藏。
entries.en: Use text commands to explore caves, manipulate objects, solve environmental puzzles and recover treasures.

entries.zh: 玩家采集泰伯利亚资源、建造基地和科技设施，调动各阵营陆空单位争夺战场。
entries.en: A science-fiction real-time strategy game about harvesting Tiberium, building bases and deploying faction-specific land and air forces.

entries.zh: 出题者在图标棋盘上放置标记，组合概念线索，让其他玩家推断目标词或短语。
entries.en: A guessing game using markers on an icon board to express clues for a target word or phrase.

entries.zh: 一款双人落子棋。玩家轮流把棋子投入竖直棋盘的列中，使其落到底部，率先横向、纵向或斜向连成四子者获胜。
entries.en: A two-player connection game: drop discs into vertical columns and make four in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally.

entries.zh: 玩家驾驶挖掘机、起重机等设备，按工序挖掘、运输、浇筑和吊装，完成建筑合同。
entries.en: A construction-vehicle simulator: operate excavators, cranes and trucks to complete excavation, transport, pouring and lifting contracts.

entries.zh: 把小球射到旋转圆盘上，避开已经附着的小球。
entries.en: Fire balls onto a rotating core without hitting attached balls.

entries.zh: 攻守双方管理装备经济，配合占位与投掷物，在安放炸弹和拆弹等目标中争取回合胜利。
entries.en: A round-based tactical FPS combining equipment economy, positioning and utility with bomb-planting and defusal objectives.

entries.zh: 攻守双方通过装备购买、枪械配合和地图控制争夺安放炸弹、拆弹或人质目标。
entries.en: A round-based team tactical FPS using equipment purchases, gunplay and map control for bomb or hostage objectives.

entries.zh: 玩家声称角色能力以取得金币、攻击或阻挡，也可挑战声明，设法让对手失去全部影响力。
entries.en: A hidden-role bluffing game involving claimed abilities, coins, attacks, blocks and challenges to eliminate opposing influence.

entries.zh: 玩家采集资源、合成装备并维持生存状态；完整版还包含多层地下城与更丰富的敌人和机制。
entries.en: Pixel-art survival-crafting environments with gathering, equipment and survival needs; the full version adds multi-floor dungeons and richer enemies.

entries.zh: 玩家在程序化世界中采集材料、制造工具、寻找食物并应对敌人，通过一系列成就推进生存进程。
entries.en: Gather materials, make tools, find food and handle enemies in a procedural world, progressing through a set of achievements.

entries.zh: 一个基于 Minetest 的三维体素交互平台。任务可让玩家导航、挖掘、采集与制作，并以可配置的世界规则定义目标。
entries.en: A Minetest-based 3D voxel platform for configurable navigation, mining, gathering and crafting tasks.

entries.zh: 玩家在爆破等模式中利用武器与队友配合，完成攻守目标并击败敌方队伍。
entries.en: A team first-person shooter about weapons, coordination and attack-defense objectives in modes such as demolition.

entries.zh: 左右调整移动方向，穿过逐渐密集的方块群并避免碰撞。
entries.en: Steer left and right through increasingly dense fields of blocks without colliding.

entries.zh: 玩家在夜之城完成委托，以枪械、潜行或黑客能力应对任务，并通过装备和义体发展角色。
entries.en: A first-person open-world action RPG set in Night City, combining quests, gunplay, stealth, hacking and cybernetic character builds.

entries.zh: 一款部分可观测六角连通棋。双方尝试连接各自对边，只能通过有限的落子反馈推断被隐藏的对手位置。
entries.en: A partially observed Hex variant about connecting opposite edges while inferring hidden opposing placements from feedback.

entries.zh: 玩家探索相互连接的区域，管理耐力并观察敌人动作，利用装备与篝火系统应对高风险战斗。
entries.en: An action RPG combining interconnected exploration, stamina management, enemy-pattern reading, equipment choices and bonfire checkpoints.

entries.zh: 玩家组织冒险小队、选择技能和补给，并管理角色的生命与压力。
entries.en: A party-based dungeon crawler with turn-based combat. Assemble a team, choose skills and supplies, and manage both health and stress.

entries.zh: 玩家暗中结盟并同步投票淘汰对象，判断他人选择以存活到最后。
entries.en: A social voting game involving secret alliances, simultaneous elimination choices and survival.

entries.zh: 玩家扮演弗兰克·韦斯特，在限时事件中救援幸存者、组合武器并拍摄照片，探索危险的娱乐都市。
entries.en: A zombie action adventure starring Frank West, combining timed events, survivor rescues, improvised weapons and photography.

entries.zh: 玩家评估物品、与顾客议价、管理现金和库存，通过买卖逐步发展店铺。
entries.en: A pawn-shop management simulation. Appraise goods, negotiate prices and manage cash and inventory while growing the business.

entries.zh: 玩家在迷宫等场景中导航、收集物品并避开危险，不同关卡设置不同目标与奖励。
entries.en: A 3D first-person task platform featuring maze navigation, object collection and hazards under level-specific goals.

entries.zh: 选择干员并利用战术装备与队友配合；可搜集物资后寻找撤离路线，也可驾驶载具参与大规模据点攻防。
entries.en: Choose operators and coordinate tactical equipment with teammates, extracting recovered loot or fighting large-scale battles with vehicles.

entries.zh: 玩家在商谈联盟的同时提交部队命令，利用协作、支持与背叛争夺补给中心。
entries.en: Negotiate alliances and submit military orders, using support and diplomacy to contest supply centers.

entries.zh: 玩家结合超自然能力、移动路线和环境机关完成暗杀任务，可选择潜入、非致命处置或正面交战。
entries.en: A first-person stealth-action game using supernatural powers and environmental routes to resolve assassination missions through lethal or nonlethal approaches.

entries.zh: 玩家控制角色左右移动，借助平台不断攀升，并避开敌人与危险区域。
entries.en: Steer left and right to keep climbing via platforms while avoiding enemies and hazards.

entries.zh: 玩家在地牢式地图中导航、射击、寻找道具与出口；ViZDoom 允许设置不同地图和奖励规则。
entries.en: A first-person shooting environment involving navigation, combat, items and exits; ViZDoom supports configurable maps and reward rules.

entries.zh: GameSense 接入的 DOOM，具体发行版本未注明。一款第一人称射击研究环境。玩家在地牢式地图中导航、射击、寻找道具与出口；ViZDoom 允许设置不同地图和奖励规则。
entries.en: GameSense DOOM integration; edition unspecified. A first-person shooting environment involving navigation, combat, items and exits; ViZDoom supports configurable maps and reward rules.

entries.zh: 玩家在多层地图中寻找钥匙和出口，管理武器弹药并与成群恶魔交战。
entries.en: A first-person shooter about navigating maps, finding keys and exits, and fighting demons with limited ammunition.

entries.zh: 玩家操控不同英雄，通过对线、击杀和资源获取发展等级与装备，协作摧毁敌方远古遗迹。
entries.en: A 5v5 MOBA: control heroes, gain levels and items through lanes and combat, and cooperate to destroy the enemy Ancient.

entries.zh: 一名地主对抗两名农民，玩家按合法牌型压制或选择不出，目标是让己方率先出完手牌。
entries.en: One landlord faces two farmers; play legal combinations or pass, aiming for your side to empty a hand first.

entries.zh: 玩家以一名旅人的身份接受村民委托，从山路出发探索周围地点，寻找处理巨龙问题的线索。通过文字指令移动、检查物品并尝试组合和使用道具，逐步解决谜题；故事既提供武力路径，也留下解除魔法的线索。
entries.en: A traveler accepts a village quest and sets out from a mountain path to find a way to deal with a dragon. Move between locations, examine objects and use items through text commands to solve connected puzzles. The opening presents both a weapon-based approach and clues to breaking an enchantment.

associationCaveat.zh: 按 EMemBench 发布的 dragon.z5 核实为 William Stott 的 Dragon Adventure（Release 2 / 040211）；文件与 Jericho 故事库逐字节一致。论文表19的 Dragon! 名称与角色描述不对应发布文件。
associationCaveat.en: The released ROM hash identifies William Stott’s Dragon Adventure (Release 2 / 040211), byte-identical to the Jericho archive. The Dragon! title and role description in paper Table 19 do not match the released file.

entries.zh: 一款双人落子棋。玩家轮流把棋子投入竖直棋盘的列中，使其落到底部，率先横向、纵向或斜向连成四子者获胜。

entries.zh: 不等式填数谜题：填写每行每列不重复的数字，同时满足格子之间的大于或小于约束。

entries.zh: 一款双人连珠棋。双方轮流在交叉点落子，争取率先横向、纵向或斜向连成五子；禁手等规则取决于具体实现。

entries.zh: 一个按规则移动圆盘的顺序规划谜题。每次只能移动一个最上层圆盘，且大盘不能压在小盘上，目标是把整叠圆盘移到指定柱。

entries.zh: 桥梁连线谜题：按岛上的数字连接水平或竖直桥梁，使各岛桥数正确且整张网络连通，桥梁不能交叉。
entries.en: Connect numbered islands with horizontal or vertical bridges, matching counts and making one connected network without crossings.

entries.zh: 算术填数谜题：每行每列数字不重复，各标记区域还须满足给定运算与目标值。
entries.en: Fill a Latin grid while satisfying arithmetic operators and target values in marked cages.

entries.zh: 管网旋转谜题：旋转各格线段，使所有终端连接到中央节点，形成连通网络。
entries.en: Rotate network tiles to connect all terminals to the central node.

entries.zh: 数织谜题：依据每行每列给出的连续黑格长度，确定整张黑白图案。
entries.en: Reconstruct a black-and-white picture from row and column run-length clues.

entries.zh: 一款通过夹击翻转对方棋子的棋类游戏。玩家选择落点形成夹击，并围绕边角与终局棋子数量展开争夺。

entries.en: Fill a Latin grid of building heights, matching visibility counts from its edges.

entries.zh: 闭环画线谜题：沿网格边画出唯一闭合回路，使各数字周围的边数与提示一致。
entries.en: Draw one closed loop along grid edges, matching the edge counts around numbered cells.

entries.zh: 黑白平衡谜题：每行每列黑白格数量相等，且不能连续出现三个同色格。
entries.en: Fill black and white cells equally in every row and column, with no run of three equal colors.

entries.en: A circuit-racing simulator emphasizing braking points, racing lines and vehicle control in time trials and multiplayer events.

entries.zh: 收集资源制造工具、打通路线并到达樱桃树。
entries.en: Gather resources, craft tools, clear a route and reach the cherry tree.

entries.zh: 玩家在网格地图中把箱子推到指定位置，需要安排移动顺序并避免把箱子推入无法恢复的位置。
entries.en: Push crates onto target squares, planning the move order to avoid irreversible deadlocks.

entries.zh: 玩家在洛圣都切换三位主角，驾驶载具、参与枪战并完成剧情任务和抢劫行动。
entries.en: An open-world crime action adventure featuring three protagonists, driving, gunfights, story missions and heists around Los Santos.

entries.zh: 玩家组合对子、顺子和炸弹等牌型，与搭档协作争取较好的出完顺序。
entries.en: A four-player partnership climbing-card game using combinations such as pairs, sequences and bombs to improve finishing order.

entries.zh: 10个模型玩家在0–100中选数，反复争取接近全体均值2/3
entries.en: Ten model players choose numbers0–100, aiming for two-thirds of the group mean

entries.zh: 控制器向左右施力移动小车，使杆保持直立并避免小车越出边界。
entries.en: Push the cart left or right to keep the pole upright while staying within the track bounds.

entries.zh: 玩家能看到伙伴的手牌，却看不到自己的牌，需要通过受限提示配合，按颜色和顺序完成烟花。
entries.en: A cooperative card game with hidden personal hands. See teammates’ cards, exchange limited hints and play cards in the correct color sequences.

entries.zh: 玩家通过关键词搜索一组警方访谈录像，从分散片段中整理线索、理解人物关系与案件经过。
entries.en: A nonlinear video mystery. Search police-interview recordings by keyword and piece together clues, relationships and events from fragmented clips.

entries.zh: 一款 11×11 六角连通棋。双方轮流放置棋子，分别争取把属于自己的两条对边连成通路。
entries.en: An 11×11 connection game: place stones to connect the two opposite edges assigned to your color.

entries.zh: 旋转中央六边形接住下落彩条，把同色块相连消除，避免堆积越界。
entries.en: Rotate a central hexagon to catch colored bars, match colors and prevent overflow.

entries.zh: 玩家操控分工不同的英雄，对线发育、争夺野区资源，并协作摧毁敌方水晶。
entries.en: A 5v5 MOBA involving hero roles, lane farming, jungle objectives and coordinated attacks on the enemy crystal.

entries.zh: 探索王者大陆，运用英雄共鸣与技能组合进行战斗，可随时组队挑战秘境和首领，并参与种植、钓鱼等活动。
entries.en: Explore the world, combine hero resonance abilities in combat, team up for dungeons and bosses, or take part in farming and fishing.

entries.zh: 玩家放置和组合物件，利用运动与连锁反应，让装置完成指定目标。
entries.en: Arrange and connect objects so that their motion and chain reactions accomplish a goal.

entries.zh: 众人通过是非问题猜目标词，知情的内鬼暗中引导，随后大家寻找内鬼。
entries.en: A question-and-deduction game: infer a word through yes/no questions, then identify the informed Insider who guided the discussion.

entries.zh: 每轮选择合作或背叛，双方行动共同决定收益，参与者可根据互动历史调整后续策略。
entries.en: A repeated two-player game about cooperation or defection, with joint-action payoffs and history-dependent choices.

entries.zh: 收集软糖、避免洋葱并持续寻找未耗尽区域。
entries.en: Collect jelly beans, avoid onions and find undepleted areas.

entries.zh: 探索层层深入的危险洞穴，寻找与使用物品、破解谜题，设法取得由古龙守护的知识宝石。
entries.en: Explore dangerous cave layers, use objects and solve puzzles to recover the Jewel of Knowledge guarded by ancient dragons.

entries.zh: 一方观察炸弹并操作模块，另一方阅读手册，通过语言沟通指导正确步骤。
entries.en: A cooperative bomb-defusal game with separated information. One player sees and operates the bomb while others consult a manual and communicate instructions.

entries.zh: 玩家驱动电机和推进器，让目标物体相接触，同时避开禁止碰撞的物体。
entries.en: A family of 2D rigid-body tasks using motors and thrusters to create target contacts while avoiding forbidden collisions.

entries.zh: 玩家控制卡比漂浮、吸入敌人并吐出攻击，穿越各关卡并挑战首领。
entries.en: A side-scrolling platformer about floating, inhaling enemies and spitting projectiles while traversing stages and fighting bosses.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 协同站位并装载食物，参与者等级之和须达到食物等级
entries.en: Coordinate positions and load food requiring sufficient combined agent levels

entries.zh: 玩家根据自己的骰子估计全场某点数的数量，逐次加码或质疑上一位的声明。
entries.en: A bluffing game about bidding on hidden dice totals or challenging the previous claim.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 一款俯视角动作冒险游戏的 Game Boy Color 版本。玩家探索可湖霖岛、收集道具并解开地牢谜题，寻找唤醒风之鱼的乐器。
entries.en: The Game Boy Color version of a top-down action adventure about exploring Koholint, solving dungeons and collecting instruments to awaken the Wind Fish.

entries.zh: 通过合法提示合作按颜色和数字顺序构建烟花。
entries.en: Cooperate through legal hints to build ordered fireworks.

entries.zh: 通过文字命令调查 Ludicorp 的办公楼，检查房间与物品，查明公司迟迟未发布新游戏的原因。
entries.en: Investigate Ludicorp's office through text commands, examining rooms and objects to discover why its game release is overdue.

entries.zh: 一款掷骰竞走棋。玩家根据骰点选择棋子前进，在绕盘过程中击回对手并把己方棋子送入终点区。
entries.en: A dice-based race game about choosing pieces to move, sending opponents home and reaching the finish with all pieces.

entries.zh: 扮演被谋杀狼神的化身，选择复活神明、追凶复仇或改变神祇秩序。
entries.en: Play the murdered Wolf god's avatar, choosing between revival, vengeance and changing the pantheon.

entries.zh: 选择魔法发展方向，参加竞赛并介入王国政治，决定效忠王室还是争取自己的权力。
entries.en: Choose magical specialties, enter tournaments and decide how to engage with royal power.

entries.zh: 在架空的 1930 年代冒险，通过剧情选择应对阴谋、追逐和战斗。
entries.en: Make narrative choices through conspiracies, chases and fights in a retro-futuristic 1930s adventure.

entries.zh: 作为死亡故事收集者，决定如何利用逝者的记忆，以及由谁掌握历史的解释权。
entries.en: Collect dying people's stories and decide how their memories will shape power and history.

entries.zh: 运用自然元素之力，在稳定失控天气魔法与利用混乱之间作出选择。
entries.en: Wield natural forces while choosing whether to stabilize broken weather magic or embrace its chaos.

entries.zh: 作为新手英雄探索受巫师威胁的城市，在冒险、谋生和个人成长间安排选择。
entries.en: Play an aspiring hero balancing city-saving adventures, earning a living and personal development.

entries.zh: 参加超级英雄真人秀，与盟友合作揭开威胁世界的阴谋。
entries.en: Compete in a superhero reality show and work with allies against a world-threatening conspiracy.

entries.zh: 参加超级英雄竞赛，利用能力争取公众支持，并处理拯救亲人的个人目标。
entries.en: Enter a superhero competition, using powers to win public support while pursuing a family rescue.

entries.zh: 扮演靠幻术伪造救世预言的英雄，在预言开始成真时选择如何应对。
entries.en: Play a hero whose fabricated prophecy begins coming true, choosing how to handle the consequences.

entries.zh: 经营 1950 年代的电影事业，通过人员、创作和人际关系选择拍摄理想作品。
entries.en: Build a film career in 1950s Hollywood through production, hiring and relationship choices.

entries.zh: 扮演星际亡命之徒的赛博格复制体，通过追逐、升级和劫案相关选择设法逃出生天。
entries.en: Play a cyborg copy of an interstellar outlaw, making choices about pursuit, upgrades and a final heist.

entries.zh: 扮演遭绑架的王室继承人，主导逃脱与营救，并设法重新夺回自己的地位。
entries.en: Play a kidnapped royal, taking charge of escape and rescue while reclaiming the throne.

entries.zh: 通过修炼与剧情抉择追求武学成就或心灵觉悟，并寻找向神龙圣者求问的机会。
entries.en: Pursue martial mastery or enlightenment through training and story choices, seeking an audience with the Dragon Sage.

entries.zh: 带领灵异清除小队调查闹鬼地铁，处理队员、竞争者和设备之间的问题。
entries.en: Lead a paranormal team through a haunted subway while managing rivals, equipment and local authorities.

entries.zh: 经营出售超能力的公司，以管理、魔法和时间旅行决策扩大企业影响力。
entries.en: Run a superpower-selling corporation through management, magic and time-travel decisions.

entries.zh: 进入莎士比亚式喜剧冒险，通过对话与剧情选择应对恋情、仙灵和伪装。
entries.en: Navigate a Shakespearean comedy through dialogue and choices involving romance, fairies and disguises.

entries.zh: 扮演被疯狂科学复活的人，在复仇、正义与超自然力量之间选择。
entries.en: Play a resurrected protagonist choosing between vengeance, justice and forbidden supernatural power.

entries.zh: 在亚瑟时代率领不列颠军队，处理战争和王位争夺中的选择。
entries.en: Lead Britons in an Arthurian setting, making choices about warfare and the struggle for the throne.

entries.zh: 扮演 2061 年的记者，通过采访、竞争与报道选择争夺新闻影响力。
entries.en: Play a reporter in 2061, competing for stories, influence and celebrity through narrative choices.

entries.zh: 在水下社会探索爱情与永生，通过选择决定愿意付出何种代价。
entries.en: Navigate an undersea society, making choices about love, immortality and their costs.

entries.zh: 加入海盗船员，通过剧情选择参与海战、营救和政治冲突，在船员忠诚、正义与个人利益之间作出取舍。
entries.en: Join a pirate crew and make story choices about battles, rescues and political conflicts, balancing loyalty, justice and personal gain.

entries.zh: 扮演职业摔跤手，在剧本表演、真实冲突和职业关系中选择发展路线。
entries.en: Play a professional wrestler choosing a path through scripted performance, real conflict and career relationships.

entries.zh: 扮演穿越到恐龙时代的物理学生，在探索记录和危险求生之间选择行动。
entries.en: Play a physics student traveling to the dinosaur era, choosing between research, exploration and survival.

entries.zh: 扮演追求不朽的强大法师，应对诸神的要求与阻挠，选择自己的飞升道路。
entries.en: Play a powerful magician seeking immortality while navigating divine demands and opposition.

entries.zh: 在 1729 年伦敦扮演赏金捕盗者，在抓捕罪犯、宽恕与牟利之间选择。
entries.en: Play a thief-taker in 1729 London, choosing between criminal hunting, mercy and profit.

entries.zh: 潜入调查致命生物武器，在身份伪装、快速应变和任务目标之间作出抉择。
entries.en: Infiltrate a deadly bioweapon operation, making choices about cover identities, quick responses and the mission.

entries.zh: 参与吸血鬼权力斗争，以政治谋略、结盟或暴力应对亲王失踪后的局势。
entries.en: Navigate vampire politics through schemes, alliances and violence after a Prince disappears.

entries.zh: 与盟友探索危险的 Deathscapes，通过剧情抉择应对 Versus 星球的新威胁。
entries.en: Explore the Deathscapes with allies, making narrative choices against a new threat on planet Versus.

entries.zh: 在外星竞技与冲突中吸收能力和记忆，争取生存并逃离 Versus 星球。
entries.en: Absorb alien powers and memories, choosing how to survive rivals and escape planet Versus.

entries.zh: 作为狼人反抗军事警察统治，在族群生存、荣誉和自由之间作出选择。
entries.en: Lead werewolf resistance against military rule, choosing between pack survival, honor and freedom.

entries.zh: 玩家构筑牌组，使用地牌获取法术力，施放生物与法术，通过攻防和卡牌组合达成胜利。
entries.en: A collectible card game about deck construction, land-based mana, creatures, spells and interacting card combinations.

entries.zh: 玩家根据手牌、牌河与可见信息调整牌型和攻守选择，具体计分随规则而异。
entries.en: A family of tile games involving draws, discards and hand construction. Adapt your hand and risk decisions using visible information; scoring varies by ruleset.

entries.zh: 船员完成任务或驱逐内鬼，内鬼隐蔽击杀并阻止船员胜利。
entries.en: Crewmates finish tasks or eject impostors; impostors conceal kills and defeat the crew.

entries.zh: 狼人通过数量优势获胜，好人淘汰全部狼人。
entries.en: Werewolves seek numerical dominance; villagers eliminate every werewolf.

entries.zh: 在改变地形、生存规则与任务依赖的世界中完成采集和制作成就。
entries.en: Unlock collection and crafting achievements in worlds with changed terrain, survival rules and task dependencies.

entries.zh: 玩家能看到伙伴的手牌，却看不到自己的牌，需要通过受限提示配合，按颜色和顺序完成烟花。
entries.en: A cooperative card game with hidden personal hands. See teammates’ cards, exchange limited hints and play cards in the correct color sequences.

entries.zh: 玩家能看到伙伴的手牌，却看不到自己的牌，需要通过受限提示配合，按颜色和顺序完成烟花。
entries.en: A cooperative card game with hidden personal hands. See teammates’ cards, exchange limited hints and play cards in the correct color sequences.

entries.zh: 玩家切换两位蜘蛛侠，在纽约摆荡移动，处理犯罪事件并使用各自能力推进战斗与剧情任务。
entries.en: An open-world superhero action adventure: switch between two Spider-Men, swing through New York and use distinct powers in combat and missions.

entries.zh: 多摄像机协作覆盖移动目标，减少重复覆盖。
entries.en: Coordinate cameras to cover moving targets with reduced overlap.

entries.zh: 在收集资源与清理公共河流之间取舍，并适应不同伙伴行为。
entries.en: Balance resource harvesting and public river cleaning with different co-players.

entries.zh: 例如在指令序列任务中，玩家需要记住不断增长的指令并按顺序重演。
entries.en: A set of interactive memory environments. In sequence tasks, remember an expanding series of instructions and replay them in order.

entries.zh: 玩家在重复寻找目标的过程中记住通道、障碍与目标位置，利用之前的观察在迷宫中导航。
entries.en: Remember corridors, obstacles and target locations across repeated searches and use prior observations to navigate.

entries.zh: 玩家先取得信件，再避开敌人把信送到对应目标。
entries.en: A text-grounded grid courier environment: collect a message and deliver it to the goal while avoiding enemies.

entries.zh: 玩家分配工人采集资源、生产单位，并调动部队攻击敌方基地。
entries.en: A lightweight 2D real-time strategy environment combining resource collection, unit production and attacks on enemy bases.

entries.zh: 玩家可以探索、采集资源、合成工具、建造建筑，并在生存模式中管理生命与饥饿，或在创造模式中自由搭建。
entries.en: A block-based sandbox game about exploration, crafting and building. Survival adds health, hunger and resource constraints; Creative offers free-form construction.

entries.zh: 玩家依据已翻开格子的数字推断相邻地雷的位置，标记危险并安全翻开其余格子。
entries.en: Use revealed numbers to infer adjacent mines, mark hazards and uncover the remaining safe squares.

entries.zh: 协作对随机技能的黑暗暴君造成伤害。
entries.en: Cooperate against the Dark Dragon's stochastic skills.

entries.zh: 玩家为不断增长的城市连接车站、安排线路与列车，缓解乘客积压并管理有限运力。
entries.en: Connect stations, organize routes and allocate trains as a city grows, using limited capacity to prevent overcrowding.

entries.zh: 采集资源、建造设施与部队，摧毁对手基地，分别迎战 SIMPLE 与 HIT N RUN 规则 AI。
entries.en: Gather resources, construct facilities/units and destroy the opponent’s base against SIMPLE and HIT N RUN rule-based AIs.

entries.zh: 角色用移动、转向、拾取和开门等操作，在钥匙、门、障碍与目标组成的地图中完成任务。
entries.en: A family of 2D grid environments using movement, turning, pickup and door operations among keys, obstacles and goals.

entries.zh: 任务可组合迷宫、河流、巨石、怪物与物品，玩家通过移动和使用物体抵达目标。
entries.en: Small NetHack-based dungeon environments combining mazes, rivers, boulders, monsters and items with navigation and interaction goals.

entries.zh: 种植和收获商品、补充货架、收银并购买升级，逐步扩大经营规模。
entries.en: Grow goods, restock shelves, serve customers and buy upgrades to expand a shop.

entries.zh: 探索月光中的神秘高塔，检查面具等物品并寻找其用途，通过文字谜题逐步揭开角色的身份与记忆。
entries.en: Explore a moonlit tower, examine masks and other objects, and solve text-based puzzles that reveal the protagonist's identity and memories.

entries.zh: 玩家利用普通技、特殊招式、跳跃和防御赢得回合，并可在胜利后施展终结技。
entries.en: A one-on-one 2D fighter using normal attacks, special moves, jumps and blocks, with finishers after victory.

entries.zh: 3智能体覆盖3个地标，避免相撞。
entries.en: Three agents cover three landmarks while avoiding collisions.

entries.zh: 机器人取出指定货架、送到工作站再归还，需要在共享通道中安排路径避免拥堵。
entries.en: A multi-robot warehouse environment about fetching shelves, delivering them to stations and returning them through shared aisles.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Jason Bourne，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on The Bourne Identity. Play Jason Bourne through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Ethan Hunt，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Mission Impossible. Play Ethan Hunt through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Raiders of the Lost Ark. Play Indiana Jones through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Indiana Jones，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom. Play Indiana Jones through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 James Bond，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Casino Royale. Play James Bond through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Red Grant，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on From Russia with Love. Play Red Grant through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Jake LaMotta，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Raging Bull. Play Jake LaMotta through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Apollo Creed，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Rocky. Play Apollo Creed through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Frank Martin，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on The Transporter. Play Frank Martin through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.

entries.zh: 参与者扮演 Driver，通过自由文本行动推进场景；叙述者须让角色反应和事件顺序与既定故事约束一致。
entries.en: An interactive narrative based on Drive. Play Driver through free-form actions while the narrator maintains story facts, commitments and event order.
