entries.zh: 参与者以自由文本行动影响场景，叙述者需保持人物事实、事件依赖与既定承诺一致。
entries.en: Interactive narrative environments based on film story specifications, combining free-form player actions with consistency constraints on facts, events and commitments.

entries.zh: 玩家驾驶跑车在不同道路上竞速，控制刹车、转向和超车，应对交通与道路变化。
entries.en: A road-racing game about sports-car handling, braking, cornering and overtaking through varied roads and traffic.

entries.zh: 玩家探索地下城、辨识药水与卷轴、利用装备和环境求生，目标是取得护符并完成升天。
entries.en: A turn-based roguelike about dungeon exploration, unidentified items and survival, culminating in recovering the Amulet and ascending.

entries.zh: 16队共128智能体在资源、NPC、缩圈与敌队压力下生存竞争
entries.en: 16 teams of 128 total agents compete under resource, NPC, shrinking-zone and enemy-team pressure

entries.zh: 在海特洛接取异象委托，与伙伴探索城市谜团并战斗；也可驾驶车辆、经营店铺和参与都市生活。
entries.en: Investigate anomalies and fight alongside companions in Hethereau, with driving, shop management and everyday city activities alongside the main adventure.

entries.zh: 玩家轮流从一堆中取走若干石子，按变体规定争取取得或避免取得最后一颗。
entries.en: A take-away game: remove stones from one pile per turn, with the last-stone objective determined by the variant.

entries.zh: 玩家在真实地理地图上铺设线路、设置车站和班次，运营列车以满足客流与运输需求。
entries.en: A railway-network simulator using real-world geography, with track construction, stations, timetables and passenger transport.

entries.zh: 一款九子棋。玩家先落子后移动，连成三子可移除对手棋子，争取让对方无法行动或剩子不足。
entries.en: A placement-and-movement game where making mills removes opponents, aiming to block them or reduce their remaining pieces.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 控制角色沿平台不断向下移动，避开尖刺与危险地板，避免掉落或被卷出画面。
entries.en: Descend through platforms, avoid spikes and dangerous floors, and stay within the scrolling play area.

entries.zh: 穿越程序生成楼层，解锁门和谜题、避开障碍，在死亡或时间耗尽前攀登尽可能多的楼层。
entries.en: Traverse procedural floors, unlock doors/solve puzzles and avoid hazards to complete as many floors as possible before death or timeout.

entries.zh: 攻击对方核心并保护己方。
entries.en: CrystalGuard is an interactive environment: Attack the enemy core while defending one's own.

entries.zh: 一款 CueChase 交互环境：搜索地图并激活触发器。
entries.en: CueChase is an interactive environment: Search the map and activate triggers.

entries.zh: 按角色限制跨区域传递物品。
entries.en: HandoffRun is an interactive environment: Pass items across role-restricted areas.

entries.zh: 一款 LastStand 交互环境：躲避危险与跌落。
entries.en: LastStand is an interactive environment: Avoid hazards and falling.

entries.zh: 一款 MidlineClash 交互环境：争夺共享资源完成订单。
entries.en: MidlineClash is an interactive environment: Compete for shared resources to fulfill orders.

entries.zh: 一款 MonsterShoot 交互环境：定位并攻击敌人。
entries.en: MonsterShoot is an interactive environment: Locate and attack enemies.

entries.zh: 一款 ObstacleRun2D 交互环境：穿越横版关卡。
entries.en: ObstacleRun2D is an interactive environment: Traverse a side-scrolling level.

entries.zh: 一款 ObstacleRun3D 交互环境：到达终点并避障。
entries.en: ObstacleRun3D is an interactive environment: Reach the finish while avoiding obstacles.

entries.zh: 完成 NPC 任务后逃脱。
entries.en: SceneEscape is an interactive environment: Complete NPC tasks to escape.

entries.zh: 一款 SharedFloor 交互环境：共享空间协作完成订单。
entries.en: SharedFloor is an interactive environment: Cooperate in shared space to fulfill orders.

entries.zh: 一款 SkyDuel 交互环境：与对手作战。
entries.en: SkyDuel is an interactive environment: Fight an opponent.

entries.zh: 一款 SoloCraft 交互环境：收集、准备并交付物品。
entries.en: SoloCraft is an interactive environment: Collect, prepare and deliver items.

entries.zh: 玩家通过对话、信息披露与投票判断他人阵营，并协作或隐瞒身份以完成阵营目标。
entries.en: A multiplayer social-deduction game with hidden roles. Use discussion, selective information and votes to infer allegiances and pursue your side’s objective.

entries.zh: 一款同时竞价的推力相扑棋。双方暗中出价，胜方把相扑手推向对手一侧，并在有限筹码下争取推出边界。
entries.en: A simultaneous-bidding sumo game: spend limited coins to push a wrestler toward the opposing edge.

entries.zh: 玩家在不断变化的厨房里分工备料、烹饪和上菜，在时间限制内完成订单；空间拥堵和设备共享让配合成为核心玩法。
entries.en: A cooperative cooking game about preparing ingredients, cooking and serving orders before time runs out. Shared equipment and crowded kitchens make teamwork central.

entries.zh: 玩家利用坦克、输出与支援英雄的不同武器和技能，围绕控制点或载具推进等地图目标作战。
entries.en: A hero-based team FPS using tank, damage and support abilities to contest objectives such as control points and payloads.

entries.zh: 通过奔跑、滑铲和跳跃穿越平台，组合动作以越过机关并到达旗帜。
entries.en: Combine running, sliding and jumping to cross platform obstacles and reach flags.

entries.zh: 一款播种棋。玩家取起一坑种子依次撒入后续坑中，通过符合条件的捕获积累种子。
entries.en: A sowing game about distributing seeds around pits and capturing them under count-based conditions.

entries.zh: 浏览器实现。在迷宫中吃掉所有豆子，同时躲避幽灵并利用能量豆反击。
entries.en: A browser implementation. An Atari 2600 game: Clear pellets from a maze, evade ghosts and use power pellets to turn the chase around.

entries.zh: 玩家探索岛屿、捕捉帕鲁并与其战斗或劳动，采集资源、建造基地并组织生产。
entries.en: An open-world survival-crafting game about capturing Pals, exploring, fighting, building bases and assigning creatures to production tasks.

entries.zh: 扮演正在 Bostwin 休假的连队指挥官，通过文字指令探索城镇、与人物交谈，并处理休假中遇到的事件。
entries.en: Play a company commander on leave in Bostwin, exploring the town and resolving encounters through text commands and conversations.

entries.zh: 玩家根据距离、地形与风向选择球杆、控制挥杆，在球场上争取以更少杆数完成比赛。
entries.en: A golf simulator about club selection and swing control, accounting for distance, terrain and wind to finish courses in fewer strokes.

entries.zh: 一款部分可观测围棋。玩家看不到对手完整布局，通过尝试落子和反馈逐步推断隐藏棋子。
entries.en: A partially observed Go variant where attempted placements and feedback reveal information about hidden opposing stones.

entries.zh: 玩家收集阳光、种植具有不同功能的植物，阻止沿多条路线前进的僵尸进入房屋。
entries.en: Collect sunlight and place plants with different roles to stop advancing zombies from reaching the house.

entries.zh: 通过跳跃穿越平台并放置炸弹，消灭敌人和障碍后逐层推进。
entries.en: Jump across platforms and place bombs to clear enemies and obstacles while climbing through stages.

entries.zh: 玩家在城都展开旅程，捕捉与培养宝可梦，利用队伍搭配和属性关系进行回合制对战。
entries.en: A Pokémon RPG set in Johto, featuring catching, training, team building and type-based turn battles.

entries.zh: 玩家在丰缘地区探索、捕捉并培养宝可梦，通过属性相克与回合制对战挑战道馆和联盟。
entries.en: A Pokémon RPG set in Hoenn, combining exploration, catching and training Pokémon, and turn-based battles against gyms and the League.

entries.zh: 在密阿雷市探索和捕捉宝可梦；战斗中训练家与宝可梦同时移动，需要判断招式范围、释放时机和替换策略。
entries.en: Explore Lumiose City and catch Pokémon; in battles, trainers and Pokémon move together, making move range, timing and switching important.

entries.zh: 玩家在关都旅行、收集宝可梦并组建队伍，以回合制战斗挑战道馆和宝可梦联盟。
entries.en: A Pokémon RPG about traveling Kanto, catching a team and battling gyms and the Pokémon League.

entries.zh: 玩家组建队伍，在回合中选择招式或替换宝可梦，利用属性、状态和队伍协同击败对手。
entries.en: A Pokémon battle simulator involving team construction, move selection, switches, type matchups and status effects.

entries.zh: 玩家打出宝可梦、附加能量并使用招式，借助训练家卡和进化组织战术，争取取得奖励卡。
entries.en: A Pokémon card game involving energy attachments, attacks, evolution and Trainer cards to take Prize cards.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 翻开牌并匹配点数或颜色，利用先前见过的位置。
entries.en: Reveal and match ranks or colors using previously seen positions.

entries.zh: 与对手反复选择合作或背叛，观察交流与互惠行为。
entries.en: Repeatedly cooperate or defect against an opponent and assess communication and reciprocity.

entries.zh: 扮演小鱼吃掉更小的鱼逐渐长大，同时躲避体型更大的鱼。
entries.en: Eat smaller fish to grow while avoiding larger fish.

entries.zh: 驾驶飞船击毁炮台后迎战首领，躲开密集弹幕并持续射击。
entries.en: Destroy turrets and fight a boss, dodging projectiles while firing.

entries.zh: 控制带惯性的飞船穿越洞穴，射击障碍并到达目标。
entries.en: Pilot an inertial ship through caves, shoot obstacles and reach the goal.

entries.zh: 在迷宫中收集绿色球体，避开追逐敌人并利用强化反击。
entries.en: Collect green orbs in a maze, evade chasers and use power-ups against them.

entries.zh: 沿平台向上攀登、收集星星，并躲避移动敌人。
entries.en: Climb platforms, collect stars and avoid moving enemies.

entries.zh: 穿越随机横版地形，跳过障碍与敌人，抵达关卡末端的金币。
entries.en: Cross randomized platform levels, avoiding hazards and enemies to reach the final coin.

entries.zh: 在俯视角房间中躲避敌人投射物，掷球击败敌人并找到出口。
entries.en: Dodge enemy projectiles in top-down rooms, throw balls and find the exit.

entries.zh: 控制向上移动的机器人穿过障碍，收集水果并避开非水果物品。
entries.en: Guide an upward-moving robot through obstacles, collecting fruit and avoiding non-fruit objects.

entries.zh: 由 16 种程序生成游戏组成的环境套件，涵盖平台跳跃、迷宫、射击和收集；每种游戏生成不同地形与物体布局。
entries.en: Sixteen procedural games spanning platforming, mazes, shooting and collection, with randomized layouts within each game.

entries.zh: 在迷宫中取得彩色钥匙，打开对应颜色的门并获得宝石。
entries.en: Collect colored keys, open matching doors and obtain the gem.

entries.zh: 在随机平台中跳跃前进，避开尖刺并抵达胡萝卜目标。
entries.en: Jump through randomized platforms, avoid spikes and reach the carrot.

entries.zh: 穿过车流与河流，借助浮木移动，在避免碰撞和落水的情况下抵达对岸。
entries.en: Cross traffic and rivers using floating logs while avoiding collisions and drowning.

entries.zh: 探索随机生成的迷宫，寻找通向奶酪目标的路径。
entries.en: Navigate a procedurally generated maze to reach the cheese.

entries.zh: 挖掘泥土收集钻石，避开会下落的岩石，并在满足条件后进入出口。
entries.en: Dig for diamonds, avoid falling rocks and reach the exit after meeting its requirement.

entries.zh: 控制忍者蓄力跳跃、攀越地形并投掷飞镖，抵达关卡终点。
entries.en: Charge jumps, traverse terrain and throw stars to reach the level's end.

entries.zh: 在海面操纵船只，射击指定颜色的敌船并避免误击友船。
entries.en: Steer a ship, shoot designated enemy colors and avoid friendly vessels.

entries.zh: 驾驶横向飞行战机击毁敌舰，避开弹幕和沿途障碍。
entries.en: Pilot a side-scrolling fighter, destroy ships and evade projectiles and obstacles.

entries.zh: 玩家搜集武器与补给，在逐渐缩小的安全区域内移动和交战，争取成为最后存活的个人或队伍。
entries.en: A battle-royale shooter: scavenge weapons, navigate a shrinking safe zone and fight to be the last surviving player or team.

entries.zh: 玩家搜集装备、驾驶载具并在缩小的安全区内转移，争取成为最后存活的队伍。
entries.en: A mobile battle-royale shooter about looting, vehicles, safe-zone movement and being the last team alive.

entries.zh: 向公共池贡献点数并争取最高最终收益。
entries.en: Contribute points to a public pool and maximize final payoff.

entries.zh: 玩家争取先到达对侧，同时利用有限墙体延长对方的通路。
entries.en: A board game combining pawn movement and wall placement. Reach the opposite side first while using limited walls to lengthen the opponent’s route.

entries.zh: 一款带局部侦察的隐藏信息国际象棋。玩家先查看一块区域，再尝试走子，通过观察和行动反馈推断对方棋局。
entries.en: A hidden-information chess variant combining local sensing with attempted moves and feedback about the opponent's position.

entries.zh: 玩家骑马探索、与人物互动、狩猎和交战，在任务推进与自由活动之间安排补给和行动。
entries.en: A Western open-world action adventure combining horseback travel, character interactions, hunting, gunfights and story missions.

entries.zh: 玩家提名行动队并表决是否出发，抵抗军争取任务成功，间谍则秘密破坏任务。
entries.en: A hidden-team game: nominate and approve mission teams, then resolve secret mission choices as resistance members or sabotaging spies.

entries.zh: 扮演会定时自动拍翼的鸽子，观察拍翼计量条并调整移动节奏，跨越屋顶缺口和尖刺以取得面包。
entries.en: Play a pigeon whose wings flap automatically; time movement against the flap meter to cross rooftop gaps and hazards for bread.

entries.zh: 扮演卷入犯罪事件的披萨外送员，通过探索、对话和使用物品阻止罪犯、躲避追杀，推进不断升级的剧情。
entries.en: As a pizza courier caught in a crime plot, explore, talk and use objects to foil criminals and evade assassins.

entries.zh: 玩家选择落点形成夹击，并围绕边角与终局棋子数量展开争夺。
entries.en: A board game about outflanking and flipping opposing discs. Choose placements to control edges and corners and maximize the final disc count.

entries.zh: 玩家根据手牌、牌河与可见信息调整牌型和攻守选择，具体计分随规则而异。
entries.en: A family of tile games involving draws, discards and hand construction. Adapt your hand and risk decisions using visible information; scoring varies by ruleset.

entries.zh: 仅靠局部画面整合拓扑并到达迷宫目标。
entries.en: Integrate local views into topology and reach the maze goal.

entries.zh: 记住曾翻开但当前隐藏的牌，匹配全部同类。
entries.en: Remember previously revealed hidden cards and match all pairs.

entries.zh: 受控球员通过跑位、传球、防守和射门争取进球，既可设置局部攻防场景，也可组织完整比赛。
entries.en: Controlled players position, pass, defend and shoot to score, in either focused scenarios or full matches.

entries.zh: 一个同时选择石头、剪刀或布的对抗游戏，三种动作互相克制。重复对局时，玩家可根据历史选择调整策略。
entries.en: A simultaneous-choice game with three cyclically dominant actions. Repeated rounds allow players to adapt choices using the history of play.

entries.zh: 驾驶车辆追逐并撞击足球，利用加速和跳跃把球送入对方球门。
entries.en: Drive, boost and jump to strike a ball into the opposing goal.

entries.zh: 在开放地图中探索、捕捉和培养精灵，搭配队伍与技能进行对战，也能参与孵蛋、采集和社交活动。
entries.en: Explore, catch and develop creatures, assemble teams and skills for battles, and take part in breeding, gathering and social activities.

entries.zh: 按规则取得能击败指定怪物的道具并战斗
entries.en: Acquire the rule-correct item and defeat the target monster

entries.zh: 玩家在带缺口的平台上奔跑和跳跃，并借助隧道侧壁改变行走平面，避免坠入太空。
entries.en: A space-tunnel runner: jump gaps and use tunnel walls to change the running surface without falling into space.

entries.zh: 玩家观察现场、检查物品与文字线索，通过联系证据推断事件经过并回答案件问题。
entries.en: A scene-investigation mystery. Inspect objects and written clues, connect evidence and infer what happened to answer case questions.

entries.zh: 玩家选举政府、秘密处理政策卡，并利用讨论和调查争取本阵营的政策或特殊胜利条件。
entries.en: A hidden-role game of government elections and secret policy choices, with faction objectives and special victory conditions.

entries.zh: 一款像素风回合制 Roguelike。玩家选择职业探索随机地牢，战斗、鉴定物品、管理饥饿和药水，逐层深入寻找护符。
entries.en: A pixel-art turn-based roguelike: choose a hero, explore random dungeons, identify items and manage hunger while descending toward the Amulet.

entries.zh: 商人秘密装货并申报，警长决定收取贿赂还是检查袋子，以合法货物和走私收益争夺得分。
entries.en: A negotiation game about declared cargo, hidden contraband, bribes and the sheriff's inspection decisions.

entries.zh: 一组规则各异的单人逻辑谜题，包含数独、桥梁、数织和回路等；玩家依据局部提示确定唯一布局或操作序列。
entries.en: A collection of single-player logic puzzles, including Sudoku, Bridges, nonograms and loops, using local clues to determine solutions.

entries.zh: 叫牌确定庄家后，一人对抗两人，通过选择定约、将牌与出牌顺序争取所需牌点。
entries.en: A three-player contract trick-taking game with bidding, a declarer facing two defenders and contract-specific trumps.

entries.zh: 一款押注与诈唬桌游。玩家秘密放下花朵或骷髅，再竞价声明能翻开多少张安全牌。
entries.en: A bluffing game of hidden flowers and skulls, with bids on how many safe cards can be revealed.

entries.zh: 玩家通过回合制卡牌战斗获得新卡和遗物，并在路线、战斗与资源消耗之间作出选择。
entries.en: Build a deck through turn-based card battles, collect relics and choose a route while managing resources across an entire run.

entries.zh: 玩家通过回合制卡牌战斗获得新卡和遗物，并在路线、战斗与资源消耗之间作出选择。
entries.en: Build a deck through turn-based card battles, collect relics and choose a route while managing resources across an entire run.

entries.zh: 虚拟角色在地点之间活动、与其他角色交流，并根据个人计划和经历安排后续行为。
entries.en: Characters move between locations, converse and organize activities using their plans and experiences.

entries.zh: 玩家吃到食物后增长身体，同时避免撞到障碍或自身。
entries.en: A movement game in which collecting food lengthens the snake. Steer through the playfield while avoiding obstacles and the snake’s own body.

entries.zh: 通过讨论和结盟争取在淘汰投票中存活；进入最后三人后，还须说服已淘汰玩家组成的陪审团投票支持自己。
entries.en: Form alliances and survive elimination votes, then persuade the eliminated players' jury to support you among the final three.

entries.zh: 玩家在网格地图中把箱子推到指定位置，需要安排移动顺序并避免把箱子推入无法恢复的位置。
entries.en: Push crates onto target squares, planning the move order to avoid irreversible deadlocks.

entries.zh: 在矩形房间中击中对面墙边随机出现的敌人。
entries.en: Hit an enemy randomly spawned along the opposite wall of a rectangular room.

entries.zh: 通过文字指令探索奇幻场景，获取并施放法术，利用物品与咒语组合破解谜题。
entries.en: Explore a fantasy world through text commands, acquiring spells and combining them with objects to solve puzzles.

entries.zh: 非间谍知道共同地点，通过提问试探身份；间谍需要隐藏身份并猜出地点。
entries.en: Players question each other about a shared secret location. The spy must blend in and infer it before being identified.

entries.zh: 把握移动方块的落下时机，尽量与下层对齐；超出的部分会被切掉，使后续空间缩小。
entries.en: Time moving blocks to align with the stack; overhang is cut away, shrinking later landing space.

entries.zh: 在团队阈值收益条件下选择 STAG 或 HARE。
entries.en: Choose STAG or HARE under threshold-dependent group payoffs.

entries.zh: 玩家采集矿物与瓦斯、建设基地、研发科技并组织军队，在侦察、经济发展和实时战斗之间分配资源与注意力。
entries.en: Gather minerals and gas, construct a base, research technology and command an army while balancing economy, scouting and combat.

entries.zh: 玩家种植作物、养殖、采矿和钓鱼，并安排每日时间、资源和社区活动。
entries.en: Grow crops, raise animals, mine and fish while organizing daily time, resources and community activities.

entries.zh: 玩家耕种、照料动物、采矿与钓鱼，并通过每日活动和赠礼经营矿石镇的人际关系。
entries.en: A farming-life simulator combining crops, animal care, mining, fishing and relationships with Mineral Town's residents.

entries.zh: 一款棋子身份隐藏的军棋。双方先布阵，再移动和交战，通过侦察与等级比较寻找并夺取敌方军旗。
entries.en: A hidden-rank strategy game involving deployment, movement and combat to capture the opponent's flag.

entries.zh: 玩家利用走位、普通攻击、投技和特殊招式，在有限时间内削减对手生命或取得优势。
entries.en: A one-on-one 2D fighting game combining spacing, normal attacks, throws and special moves in timed rounds.

entries.zh: 玩家把握距离与连招时机，运用特殊技和格挡系统，在逐回合对战中击败对手。
entries.en: A 2D fighting game emphasizing spacing, combos, special moves and parries across competitive rounds.

entries.zh: 根据已有数字填满网格，使每行、每列和指定区域中的数字满足不重复约束。
entries.en: Complete the grid so that rows, columns and designated regions satisfy the no-repetition constraints.

entries.zh: 玩家控制马力欧奔跑、跳跃和获取强化，躲开敌人与障碍并到达关卡终点。
entries.en: A side-scrolling platformer about running, jumping, collecting power-ups and reaching each level's exit.

entries.zh: 玩家控制马力欧跨越平台和敌人，收集强化，并穿插驾驶载具的射击关卡。
entries.en: A side-scrolling platformer with jumps, enemies, power-ups and vehicle-shooting stages.

entries.zh: 玩家操控马力欧奔跑和跳跃，穿过敌人与机关以推进关卡。
entries.en: The platform game integrated by Orak, involving Mario's running and jumping through enemies and obstacles.

entries.zh: 玩家通过移动、攻击与防御累积对手伤害，并将对方击出场地边界。
entries.en: A platform fighter about movement, attacks and defense, increasing damage to knock opponents beyond arena boundaries.

entries.zh: 玩家驾驶卡丁车通过赛道，利用漂移、加速和道具对抗其他车手。
entries.en: A kart racer combining circuit driving, drifting, boosts and items against other racers.

entries.zh: 横版平台动作游戏，跳跃穿越场景并使用远程攻击对付敌人。
entries.en: A side-scrolling platformer combining traversal and ranged combat.

entries.zh: 赛道竞速游戏，与四名对手比赛并完成三圈。
entries.en: A circuit racer with four opponents and three laps.

entries.zh: 纵向飞行射击游戏，移动飞船并射击连续来袭的敌人波次。
entries.en: A vertical shooter about steering and shooting through enemy waves.

entries.zh: 网格物流谜题，在确定性的格子系统中规划物体运输路线。
entries.en: A deterministic grid puzzle about routing objects through a yard.

entries.zh: 小规模战争策略游戏，由英雄带领军队争夺战场。
entries.en: A strategy game about hero-led armies and battlefield control.

entries.zh: 三维搬运闯关游戏，携带能量电池穿越移动危险区并完成交付。
entries.en: A 3D delivery game about carrying power cells through moving hazards.

entries.zh: 飞行驾驶游戏，完成起飞、穿越检查点和着陆流程。
entries.en: A flight game combining takeoff, checkpoints and landing.

entries.zh: 跑酷游戏，通过变道、跳跃、滑行和转弯避开沿途障碍。
entries.en: A runner using lane changes, jumps, slides and turns.

entries.zh: 出租车驾驶游戏，接送乘客并在时间限制内赚取车费。
entries.en: A taxi-driving game about carrying passengers and earning fares under time limits.

entries.zh: 六层地牢战斗游戏，逐层突破并挑战最终监督者。
entries.en: A six-floor dungeon-combat game ending in an Overseer encounter.

entries.zh: 陪伴式探索游戏，与有自主行为的牵绳伙伴一起完成日常差事。
entries.en: An exploration game about completing errands with an autonomous leashed companion.

entries.zh: 俯视角科幻射击游戏，沿危险路线移动并与敌人交战。
entries.en: A top-down science-fiction shooter about progressing through a hostile course.

entries.zh: 定时状态切换平台游戏，利用世界变化与可操作地形通过关卡。
entries.en: A platform game involving timed world-state changes and terrain interactions.

entries.zh: 双角色合作解谜游戏，协调火与水两种角色穿过机关，到达成对出口。
entries.en: A two-character puzzle about coordinating elemental characters to reach paired exits.

entries.zh: 地牢射击游戏，清除房间、购买武器并挑战首领。
entries.en: A dungeon shooter about clearing rooms, buying weapons and defeating bosses.

entries.zh: 农场经营策略游戏，在期限内安排种植、交易和资源使用。
entries.en: A farming-management game about scheduling production and trading under deadlines.

entries.zh: 障碍闯关动作游戏，穿越连续危险区域到达终点。
entries.en: An obstacle-course game about traversing successive hazards.

entries.zh: 横向飞行追逐游戏，持续前进并躲开沿途障碍。
entries.en: A side-scrolling flight-chase game about avoiding obstacles.

entries.zh: 烹饪时间管理游戏，在限时内处理食材并完成餐食。
entries.en: A timed cooking game about preparing food and completing meals.

entries.zh: 球形世界探索游戏，穿行于曲面场景并重新点亮六座信标。
entries.en: A spherical-world traversal game about relighting six beacons.

entries.zh: 俯视角忍者战斗游戏，通过移动和攻击应对场景中的敌人。
entries.en: A top-down ninja combat game about movement and attacks.

entries.zh: 防守策略动作游戏，经营防御资源，并结合射击和移动抵御来敌。
entries.en: A defense-action game combining resource economy, shooting and traversal.

entries.zh: 限时配送游戏，规划多件货物的运送顺序和路线。
entries.en: A delivery game about routing multiple items before deadlines.

entries.zh: 设施潜入动作游戏，在封锁环境中移动并与敌人交战。
entries.en: An infiltration-action game about traversing a locked-down facility and fighting enemies.

entries.zh: 精确平台跳跃游戏，控制起跳与落点，依次通过四个房间。
entries.en: A precision platformer about timing jumps through four rooms.

entries.zh: 潜行破坏游戏，避开警卫巡逻完成渗透行动。
entries.en: A stealth-sabotage game about infiltrating while avoiding guards.

entries.zh: 四轨节奏游戏，在音符到达判定位置时按下相应轨道。
entries.en: A four-lane rhythm game about hitting scrolling notes at the right moment.

entries.zh: 遗物运送动作游戏，清理房间并携带遗物穿越危险，尽量减少受伤。
entries.en: An action game about clearing rooms and transporting a relic while avoiding damage.

entries.zh: 波次生存动作游戏，抵御敌人并购买升级以应对后续攻击。
entries.en: A wave-survival game about fighting enemies and purchasing upgrades.

entries.zh: 竞技场防守游戏，抵御连续敌人波次以守住阵地。
entries.en: An arena-defense game about holding out against enemy waves.

entries.zh: 潜行游戏，操控没有武器的角色穿越警卫巡逻区域。
entries.en: A stealth game about crossing guarded spaces without weapons.

entries.zh: 足球闯关游戏，运用抢断、传球和射门完成比赛。
entries.en: A soccer game combining tackles, passing and shooting across a tournament.

entries.zh: 实时生产经营游戏，安排货物生产、运输和销售。
entries.en: A real-time management game about producing, transporting and selling goods.

entries.zh: 地牢冒险游戏，逐层战斗、拾取战利品并推进四层地下城。
entries.en: A four-floor dungeon adventure about combat and loot.

entries.zh: 沙盒制作游戏，在带种子的地形中采集、制作并完成生成目标。
entries.en: A sandbox-crafting game with seeded terrain and generated objectives.

entries.zh: 俯视角地牢动作游戏，探索房间、战斗并寻找逃脱路线。
entries.en: A top-down dungeon game combining combat and escape.

entries.zh: 六角棋盘策略游戏，轮流部署行动并对抗脚本对手。
entries.en: A hex-board strategy game against a scripted opponent.

entries.zh: 动量平台游戏，利用速度穿越赛道，并在共享死亡次数限制内完成路线。
entries.en: A momentum platformer about completing courses under a shared death budget.

entries.zh: 挡板对抗游戏，来回击球并破坏场上的砖墙。
entries.en: A paddle duel with a destructible wall.

entries.zh: 恐怖生存探索游戏，在敌对环境中搜集和管理有限资源。
entries.en: A horror-survival exploration game about managing resources in hostile surroundings.

entries.zh: 迷宫收集游戏，在五张迷宫中寻找并收集宝物。
entries.en: A treasure-collection game across five mazes.

entries.zh: 扮演王子 Theo，在固定场景间移动，用观察、打开和敲击等命令调查环境，并以武器和法术击败敌人、寻找解救王国的道路。
entries.en: As Prince Theo, move between scenes, investigate using look, open and hit commands, and use weapons and spells against enemies.

entries.zh: 扮演 Theo 寻回失窃的希望之剑，探索各地并招募同伴，控制三名角色组成的队伍应对战斗与冒险。
entries.en: As Theo, recover the stolen Sword of Hope, explore and recruit allies, and command a three-character party through the adventure.

entries.zh: 从棋盘边缘发射光线，根据出口与偏折反馈推断隐藏球的位置。
entries.en: A deduction puzzle: fire rays into a black box and infer hidden balls from their exits and deflections.

entries.zh: 按岛上的数字连接水平或竖直桥梁，使各岛桥数正确且整张网络连通，桥梁不能交叉。
entries.en: Connect numbered islands with horizontal or vertical bridges, matching counts and making one connected network without crossings.

entries.zh: 在平面格子间翻滚立方体，通过格面交换颜色，设法让六个面全部染蓝。
entries.en: Roll a cube across a grid, exchanging colors with cells until all six faces are blue.

entries.zh: 把数字网格分成两格骨牌，使每种无序数字组合恰好出现一次。
entries.en: Partition a numbered grid into dominoes so every unordered number pair appears exactly once.

entries.zh: 利用一个空格逐次滑动相邻数字方块，把十五块拼回规定顺序。
entries.en: Slide numbered tiles into a single empty space to restore the fifteen-tile ordering.

entries.zh: 相连的同数格组成区域，区域包含的格数必须等于其数字。
entries.en: Fill a grid so each connected region of equal digits has an area equal to that digit.

entries.zh: 点击格子同时翻转指定邻居，寻找让所有灯格处于开启状态的操作序列。
entries.en: Toggle a cell and its marked neighbors to turn every cell on.

entries.zh: 反复改变左上角连通区域的颜色，在规定步数内覆盖整张棋盘。
entries.en: Change the top-left region's color to absorb neighboring cells and flood the board within a move limit.

entries.zh: 围绕给定圆点划分格子区域，使每个区域关于自身圆点旋转 180 度后保持相同。
entries.en: Partition cells into regions with 180-degree rotational symmetry around their marked centers.

entries.zh: 提交颜色序列，利用颜色正确与位置正确的反馈逐步确定隐藏密码。
entries.en: Guess a color sequence using feedback about correct colors and correct positions.

entries.zh: 让小球沿直线滑到阻挡物处，收集所有宝石并避开地雷。
entries.en: Slide a ball until blocked, collecting gems while avoiding mines.

entries.zh: 每行每列数字不重复，各标记区域还须满足给定运算与目标值。
entries.en: Fill a Latin grid while satisfying arithmetic operators and target values in marked cages.

entries.zh: 照亮所有白格，满足黑格旁的灯泡数量，同时避免任意两只灯泡相互照射。
entries.en: Place bulbs to illuminate every white cell, satisfy numbered black cells and prevent bulbs from seeing each other.

entries.zh: 沿网格边画出唯一闭合回路，使各数字周围的边数与提示一致。
entries.en: Draw one closed loop along grid edges, matching the edge counts around numbered cells.

entries.zh: 为双格磁铁安排正负极，满足行列极性计数，并避免同极直接相邻。
entries.en: Assign magnet polarities to domino cells, meeting row and column counts without adjacent like poles.

entries.zh: 用四种颜色为区域着色，使所有共享边界的区域颜色不同。
entries.en: Color map regions with four colors so neighboring regions never share a color.

entries.zh: 根据周边地雷数推断危险格，翻开所有非雷格并避开地雷。
entries.en: Infer mines from adjacent counts and uncover every safe cell.

entries.zh: 把格子涂成黑白两色，使每条数字提示等于其周围九宫格内的黑格数量。
entries.en: Color cells black or white so each clue equals the black-cell count in its surrounding 3×3 area.

entries.zh: 旋转各格线段，使所有终端连接到中央节点，形成连通网络。
entries.en: Rotate network tiles to connect all terminals to the central node.

entries.zh: 整体滑动行或列中的线段格，把打乱的管网重新连接起来。
entries.en: Slide entire rows or columns to reconnect a scrambled network.

entries.zh: 把棋盘划为面积相同的连通区域，使数字周围的围栏数量符合提示。
entries.en: Partition the grid into equal-area connected regions, matching boundary counts around clues.

entries.zh: 依据每行每列给出的连续黑格长度，确定整张黑白图案。
entries.en: Reconstruct a black-and-white picture from row and column run-length clues.

entries.zh: 画一条经过黑白圆点的闭合回路，分别满足黑点转弯和白点直行等局部规则。
entries.en: Draw one loop through black and white pearls, obeying their distinct turning and straight-line rules.

entries.zh: 让棋子跳过相邻棋子并移除被跳过者，争取最终只剩一枚。
entries.en: Jump pegs over adjacent pegs, removing the jumped pieces until only one remains.

entries.zh: 将部分格子涂黑，使数字可见的横竖白格数正确，同时保持白格连通。
entries.en: Shade cells so numbered clues see the required horizontal and vertical white cells, keeping the white region connected.

entries.zh: 把网格分成矩形，每块恰含一个数字，且面积等于该数字。
entries.en: Partition a grid into rectangles, each containing one number equal to its area.

entries.zh: 移除相连的同色方块，剩余方块下落并合拢，争取清空棋盘。
entries.en: Remove connected same-color clusters as blocks fall and columns close, aiming to clear the board.

entries.zh: 沿各格箭头方向连接数字，把所有格子串成从 1 到末项的连续序列。
entries.en: Follow cell arrows to link all cells into one consecutive numbered sequence.

entries.zh: 涂黑重复数字，使每行每列剩余数字不重复；黑格不能相邻，白格须保持连通。
entries.en: Shade duplicate numbers so remaining row and column values are unique, with separated black cells and connected white cells.

entries.zh: 整体推动一行或一列，使越界数字从另一侧回到棋盘，最终恢复数字顺序。
entries.en: Shift wrapping rows or columns to restore a numbered tile ordering.

entries.zh: 每格放一条对角线，满足顶点的相邻线数，并且不能形成闭环。
entries.en: Place one diagonal per cell, matching vertex counts without forming cycles.

entries.zh: 填写数字，使每行、每列及规定宫格内的数字各不重复。
entries.en: Fill digits so rows, columns and marked boxes each contain no repeated values.

entries.zh: 为每棵树配一顶相邻帐篷，满足行列数量，帐篷彼此不能接触，包括对角。
entries.en: Place a tent beside each tree, meeting row and column counts while keeping tents apart, including diagonally.

entries.zh: 每行每列填不重复的楼高，满足从边缘观察到的可见楼数提示。
entries.en: Fill a Latin grid of building heights, matching visibility counts from its edges.

entries.zh: 把起点和终点连成铁路，并满足每行每列规定的轨道格数。
entries.en: Connect the endpoints with a railway meeting row and column track-cell counts.

entries.zh: 旋转选定的小方块区域，把打乱的数字格恢复为目标排列。
entries.en: Rotate small blocks of tiles to restore the target numbered arrangement.

entries.zh: 在带镜子的网格中放置幽灵、吸血鬼和僵尸，使边缘视线中的可见怪物数符合提示。
entries.en: Place ghosts, vampires and zombies among mirrors, satisfying edge clues under their different reflection-visibility rules.

entries.zh: 填写每行每列不重复的数字，同时满足格子之间的大于或小于约束。
entries.en: Fill a Latin grid while respecting greater-than and less-than relations between cells.

entries.zh: 每行每列黑白格数量相等，且不能连续出现三个同色格。
entries.en: Fill black and white cells equally in every row and column, with no run of three equal colors.

entries.zh: 拖动图上的顶点，让所有连线互不相交。
entries.en: Move graph vertices until no connecting edges cross.

entries.zh: 玩家选择九种职业，在夺旗、控制点或护送载具等模式中配合完成地图目标。
entries.en: A class-based team FPS with nine classes cooperating on objectives such as capture-the-flag, control points and payload escort.

entries.zh: 角色自动奔跑，玩家转弯、跳跃、滑行和切换路线，避开陷阱并收集沿途金币。
entries.en: A 3D endless runner combining turns, jumps, slides and lane changes to avoid traps and collect coins.

entries.zh: 玩家旋转并摆放不同形状的方块，填满水平行以消除它们，同时避免方块堆到顶部。
entries.en: Rotate and position pieces to complete and clear horizontal lines before the stack reaches the top.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 玩家阅读房间和物体描述，通过文本命令探索、拾取、开关和组合物品，完成可配置目标。
entries.en: A text-adventure framework where typed commands explore rooms and manipulate objects to complete configurable goals.

entries.zh: 利用房间连接关系到目标位置完成取放。
entries.en: Navigate room connections to the target for pick-and-place.

entries.zh: 将3至5个有量值的物体按指定次序放入盒子。
entries.en: Place three to five quantified objects into a box in the required order.

entries.zh: 把物体收集并放回通常所属的位置。
entries.en: Collect objects and put them in their usual locations.

entries.zh: 玩家在巨型都市中执行任务，以枪械、掩体和增强技能对抗敌人，收集战利品升级装备。
entries.en: A cyberpunk top-down action RPG combining missions, gunfights, cover, augmentations and equipment progression in an arcology.

entries.zh: 在暴风雨中的墓穴醒来，探索墓地与废弃教堂，检查物品和线索，弄清自身处境并设法脱离危险。
entries.en: Awaken in a rain-soaked grave, explore the cemetery and abandoned church, and investigate objects and clues to understand and escape your predicament.

entries.zh: 玩家争取形成指定连线，同时阻止对手；不同变体使用不同棋盘与落子限制。
entries.en: A family of alternating-move alignment games. Form a winning line while blocking the opponent; variants change the board and legal-move restrictions.

entries.zh: 每次只能移动一个最上层圆盘，且大盘不能压在小盘上，目标是把整叠圆盘移到指定柱。
entries.en: Move one topmost disk at a time without placing a larger disk on a smaller one, transferring the stack to the target peg.

entries.zh: 建造/升级防御并调遣单位阻止敌人抵达基地
entries.en: Build/upgrade defenses and deploy units to prevent enemies reaching the base

entries.zh: 玩家在精确设计的赛道上控制转向、加速与漂移，反复优化路线和操作以缩短完赛时间。
entries.en: A time-trial racer about steering, acceleration and drifting on precise courses, refining driving lines to reduce completion time.

entries.zh: 一款连接棋。双方放置柱子，以骑士步距离的连线搭桥，形成连接己方对边且不与已有桥交叉的通路。
entries.en: A connection game using posts and noncrossing knight-distance links to join opposite board edges.

entries.zh: 玩家通过尝试了解各选项的回报，在探索未知收益和利用已知收益之间取舍。
entries.en: A repeated choice between two reward sources. Sample the options to learn their payoffs, balancing exploration against using the best-known option.

entries.zh: 一款嵌套井字棋：九个小棋盘组成大棋盘。落子位置决定对手下一步进入哪个小棋盘，赢下小棋盘后争取在大棋盘连线。
entries.en: Nine tic-tac-toe boards form a larger board. Each move directs the opponent's next board; winning local boards builds a global line.

entries.zh: 多数玩家拿到相同词语，少数人拿到相近词或空白身份，轮流描述并投票找出异类。
entries.en: A social deduction game with secret words. Players describe related but differing prompts, then vote to identify the minority role.

entries.zh: 玩家根据公开信息、下注历史与牌型作出跟注、加注或弃牌等决策；具体规则随变体而异。
entries.en: A family of card games with hidden hands and betting. Use public information and betting history to choose calls, raises or folds; details depend on the variant.

entries.zh: 玩家按颜色或数字匹配上一张牌，并利用功能牌改变出牌节奏，争取率先出完手牌。
entries.en: Match the previous card by color or number and use action cards to change turn flow, aiming to empty your hand.

entries.zh: 玩家采集、制作和建造营地，航海探索不同生态区，挑战首领以推进装备与资源获取。
entries.en: A Norse survival game combining gathering, crafting, base building, sailing and boss fights across distinct biomes.

entries.zh: 攻守双方管理回合经济，利用枪械和技能争夺爆能器安放与拆除目标。
entries.en: A team tactical FPS combining agent abilities, round economy, gunplay and spike planting or defusal.

entries.zh: 控制角色奔跑、跳跃和攀越障碍，穿过尖刺等机关并到达检查点和终点。
entries.en: Run, jump and climb through traps to reach checkpoints and the finish.

entries.zh: 多名智能体到达各自目标，同时避免碰撞。
entries.en: Agents reach their respective goals while avoiding collisions.

entries.zh: 二传先触球传给攻击者，再向下扣入目标区
entries.en: Setter passes to attacker, who spikes downward into the target region

entries.zh: 玩家操纵联网设施、无人机与车辆，通过侦察、潜行或战斗完成任务。
entries.en: An open-world hacking action adventure using connected infrastructure, drones and vehicles for reconnaissance, infiltration and combat.

entries.zh: 狼人夜间行动，白天所有人通过发言、质询与投票淘汰嫌疑人，双方争取达成阵营胜利。
entries.en: A hidden-role game alternating night actions with daytime discussion and elimination votes, as wolves and villagers pursue opposing objectives.

entries.zh: 玩家扮演猎魔人杰洛特，调查委托、追踪怪物，以剑术、法印和炼金准备完成战斗。
entries.en: A story-driven open-world action RPG about Geralt's investigations and monster contracts, combining swordplay, signs and alchemical preparation.

entries.zh: 在第一人称迷宫中寻找钥匙与出口，搜集弹药并射击守卫。
entries.en: Navigate first-person mazes, find keys and exits, collect ammunition and shoot guards.

entries.zh: 玩家根据每次猜测得到的字母位置反馈，在有限次数内找出目标单词。
entries.en: Use letter-position feedback from each guess to identify a hidden word within a limited number of attempts.

entries.zh: 移动红色方块躲开运动中的蓝色障碍，收集黄色目标后到达安全终点。
entries.en: Move a red square past moving blue hazards, collect yellow targets and reach the safe goal.

entries.zh: 控制红色方块穿过更复杂的移动障碍布局，收集目标并在安全区之间规划移动时机。
entries.en: Guide a red square through complex moving hazards, collecting targets and timing movement between safe areas.

entries.zh: 玩家探索、解谜并收集声骸，在实时战斗中通过闪避、反击和角色切换击败敌人。
entries.en: An open-world action RPG combining exploration, puzzles, Echo collection and real-time combat with dodges, counters and character switching.

entries.zh: 一组程序生成的三维交互世界。玩家导航、操纵物体并尝试触发规则，根据场景中的目标条件取得奖励。
entries.en: Procedural 3D worlds involving navigation, object manipulation and rule-triggering to satisfy scenario goals.

entries.zh: 一组带可变规则的网格世界。玩家探索物体交互和变换，发现当前规则并完成各回合给出的目标。
entries.en: Grid worlds with changing interaction rules, requiring exploration of object transformations to satisfy episode-specific goals.

entries.zh: 玩家有限次重掷五颗骰子，选择保留骰子，并把结果填写到不同组合计分栏。
entries.en: A dice-scoring game about selective rerolls and assigning five-dice combinations to scoring categories.

entries.zh: 探索海拉鲁之外的霍洛德拉姆，使用四季之杖改变季节，以不同地形状态解开谜题并探索地牢。
entries.en: Explore Holodrum, use the Rod of Seasons to change terrain conditions and solve overworld and dungeon puzzles.

entries.zh: 通过文字命令探索地下帝国，收集宝物、管理随身物品并解开环境谜题。
entries.en: Explore the Great Underground Empire through text commands, collecting treasures and solving inventory and environmental puzzles.

entries.zh: 在地下帝国的深处探索、收集和使用物品，破解谜题并应对巫师的干扰。
entries.en: Explore deeper underground, use collected objects, solve puzzles and contend with a wizard's interference.

entries.zh: 通过文字指令探索地下城主的领域，解开相互关联的谜题并接受最终考验。
entries.en: Explore the Dungeon Master's domain through text commands, solving linked puzzles and facing a final trial.
